";
figure=function(){return `<div class="motion-card-inner"><img src="${V42_MOVEMENT_IMAGE}" alt="Jado movement sequence illustration"></div>`};

function v42CloseDetail(){document.getElementById('v42-detail-modal')?.remove()}
window.v42CloseDetail=v42CloseDetail;
function v42OpenDetail(data){v42CloseDetail();const modal=document.createElement('div');modal.id='v42-detail-modal';modal.className='cms-detail-modal';const image=data.image?resolveAssetPath(data.image):'';modal.innerHTML=`<article class="cms-detail-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"><button type="button" class="cms-detail-close" onclick="v42CloseDetail()" aria-label="Close">×</button>${image?`<img class="cms-detail-image" src="${image}" alt="${cmsEscape(data.title||'WJO item')}">`:''}<div class="cms-detail-copy"><div class="kicker">${cmsEscape(data.category||data.kind||'WJO')}</div><h2>${cmsEscape(data.title||'')}</h2><div class="cms-detail-meta">${data.date?`<span>${cmsFmtDate(data.date)}</span>`:''}${data.author?`<span>${cmsEscape(data.author)}</span>`:''}${data.venue?`<span>${cmsEscape(data.venue)}</span>`:''}${data.location?`<span>${cmsEscape(data.location)}</span>`:''}</div><p>${cmsEscape(data.body||data.summary||data.desc||data.notes||'')}</p></div></article>`;modal.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===modal)v42CloseDetail()});document.body.appendChild(modal)}
window.v42OpenDetail=v42OpenDetail;
function cmsShowNews(id){const x=cmsRecord('news',id);if(!x)return;v42OpenDetail({title:x.title,category:x.category,date:x.date,author:x.author,image:x.image,body:x.body||x.summary})}
window.cmsShowNews=cmsShowNews;
cmsNewsCard=function(x){const image=x.image||'assets/news-newsletter.jpg';const cls=x.seed?'':' cms-public-added';return `<article class="news-card cms-clickable-news${cls}" style="--newsbg:url('${image}');position:relative" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Read ${cmsEscape(x.title)}" onclick="cmsShowNews('${x.id}')" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();cmsShowNews('${x.id}')} "><div class="tag">${cmsEscape(x.category||'WJO News')}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.title)}</h3><p style="color:#d3d7de">${cmsEscape(x.summary||'')}</p><div class="cms-record-meta"><span>${cmsFmtDate(x.date)}</span><span>${cmsEscape(x.author||'WJO')}</span></div><span class="chip-soft" style="margin-top:12px">READ STORY →</span></article>`};

cmsShowEvent=function(type,id){const x=cmsRecord(type,id);if(!x)return;v42OpenDetail({title:x.title,category:type==='gradings'?'Grading • '+(x.region||'WJO'):(x.category||'WJO Event'),date:x.date,venue:x.venue,location:x.location||x.region||'',image:x.image||'',body:x.desc||x.notes||''})};
window.cmsShowEvent=cmsShowEvent;
cmsEventRow=function(x){const cls=x.seed?'':' cms-public-added';const img=x.image?`<div class="cms-event-thumb-v42"><img src="${resolveAssetPath(x.image)}" alt="${cmsEscape(x.title)}"></div>`:`<div class="cms-event-thumb-v42 cms-event-placeholder-v44" aria-hidden="true"><img src="${V38_LOGO}" alt=""><span>${x._type==='gradings'?'GRADING':'WJO EVENT'}</span></div>`;return `<article class="event-row-v28 cms-clickable-event${cls}" style="position:relative" tabindex="0" role="button" onclick="cmsShowEvent('${x._type}','${x.id}')" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();cmsShowEvent('${x._type}','${x.id}')} ">${img}<div class="event-date-v28"><div class="day">${String(new Date(x.date+'T12:00:00').getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}</div><div><div class="month">${new Date(x.date+'T12:00:00').toLocaleString('en-GB',{month:'short'}).toUpperCase()}</div><div class="weekday">${new Date(x.date+'T12:00:00').toLocaleString('en-GB',{weekday:'short'})}</div></div></div><div class="event-body-v28"><div class="kicker">${cmsEscape(x.category||'WJO Event')}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.title)}</h3><p>${cmsEscape(x.desc||'')}</p><span class="venue">${cmsEscape(x.venue||'')} ${x.location?'• '+cmsEscape(x.location):''}</span></div><button class="btn ghost event-detail-button" type="button" onclick="event.stopPropagation();cmsShowEvent('${x._type}','${x.id}')">VIEW DETAILS</button></article>`};

// Functional media library stored locally on this device.
const V42_MEDIA_KEY='wjo-v42-media-library';
function v42MediaSeed(){return [
 {id:'media-ogden',name:'master-ogden-temple.jpg',title:'Grand Master Jake Ogden',alt:'Grand Master Jake Ogden portrait',folder:'Instructor Photos',src:'assets/instructor-master-ogden.png',seed:true},
 {id:'media-nicola',name:'nicola-ogden-profile.jpg',title:'Nicola Ogden',alt:'Nicola Ogden profile photograph',folder:'Committee',src:'assets/instructor-nicola.png',seed:true},
 {id:'media-newsletter',name:'jado-newsletter.jpg',title:'Jado Newsletter',alt:'Jado newsletter image',folder:'News & Events',src:'assets/news-newsletter.jpg',seed:true},
 {id:'media-mental',name:'mental-health.jpg',title:'Mental health and Jado',alt:'Jado wellbeing article',folder:'News & Events',src:'assets/news-mental.jpg',seed:true},
 {id:'media-brackley',name:'brackley-venue.jpg',title:'Brackley venue',alt:'Brackley school venue',folder:'School Locations',src:'assets/venue-real-brackley.png',seed:true},
 {id:'media-superjs',name:'super-js-programme.png',title:"Super J's",alt:"Super J's programme",folder:'Programmes',src:'assets/program-superjs.png',seed:true},
 {id:'media-movement',name:'jado-movement-sequence.png',title:'Jado movement sequence',alt:'Jado movement sequence illustration',folder:'Programmes',src:V42_MOVEMENT_IMAGE,seed:true}
]}
function v42MediaLoad(){try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(V42_MEDIA_KEY);if(raw){const d=JSON.parse(raw);if(Array.isArray(d))return d}}catch(e){}const d=v42MediaSeed();try{localStorage.setItem(V42_MEDIA_KEY,JSON.stringify(d))}catch(e){}return d}
function v42MediaSave(list){try{localStorage.setItem(V42_MEDIA_KEY,JSON.stringify(list))}catch(e){cmsNotify('Storage warning','The browser storage is full; export a backup before adding more large images.')}return list}
function v42MediaGet(id){return v42MediaLoad().find(x=>x.id===id)}
function v42MediaSrc(item){return item?resolveAssetPath(item.src||''):''}
function v42MediaBytes(dataUrl){return dataUrl?.startsWith('data:')?Math.round((dataUrl.length*3/4)/1024):0}
function v42MediaId(){return 'media-'+Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7)}
function v42CompressImage(file){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const reader=new FileReader();reader.onerror=reject;reader.onload=()=>{const img=new Image();img.onerror=reject;img.onload=()=>{const max=1200,scale=Math.min(1,max/Math.max(img.width,img.height));const w=Math.max(1,Math.round(img.width*scale)),h=Math.max(1,Math.round(img.height*scale));const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;const ctx=c.getContext('2d');ctx.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);let url;try{url=c.toDataURL('image/webp',.82)}catch(e){url=c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.82)}resolve({url,width:w,height:h})};img.src=reader.result};reader.readAsDataURL(file)})}
async function v42UploadMediaInput(input,forPicker){const files=[...(input.files||[])].filter(f=>f.type.startsWith('image/'));if(!files.length)return;let list=v42MediaLoad();let first=null;for(const f of files){try{const out=await v42CompressImage(f);const item={id:v42MediaId(),name:f.name,title:f.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,''),alt:f.name.replace(/[-_]/g,' ').replace(/\.[^.]+$/,''),folder:'Uploads',src:out.url,width:out.width,height:out.height,seed:false,createdAt:new Date().toISOString()};list.unshift(item);if(!first)first=item}catch(e){alert('Could not read '+f.name)}}v42MediaSave(list);cmsNotify('Image uploaded',files.length===1?'The image was added to the local media library.':files.length+' images were added.');if(forPicker&&first){v42MediaUse(first.id)}else{render()}}
window.v42UploadMediaInput=v42UploadMediaInput;
function v42DeleteMedia(id){const item=v42MediaGet(id);if(!item)return;if(!confirm(`Delete "${item.name}" from the local media library?`))return;v42MediaSave(v42MediaLoad().filter(x=>x.id!==id));cmsNotify('Image deleted','The media library has been updated.');render()}
window.v42DeleteMedia=v42DeleteMedia;
function v42EditMedia(id){const item=v42MediaGet(id);if(!item)return;const form=document.getElementById('v42-media-edit-form');if(!form)return;form.elements.id.value=item.id;form.elements.name.value=item.name||'';form.elements.title.value=item.title||'';form.elements.alt.value=item.alt||'';form.elements.folder.value=item.folder||'Uploads';const img=document.getElementById('v42-media-editor-img');img.src=v42MediaSrc(item);img.alt=item.alt||item.title||item.name;document.getElementById('v42-media-editor-heading').textContent='Editing '+item.name;form.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'})}
window.v42EditMedia=v42EditMedia;
async function v42SaveMedia(e){e.preventDefault();const f=e.currentTarget;const id=f.elements.id.value;let list=v42MediaLoad();const idx=list.findIndex(x=>x.id===id);if(idx<0)return;const item={...list[idx],name:f.elements.name.value.trim()||list[idx].name,title:f.elements.title.value.trim(),alt:f.elements.alt.value.trim(),folder:f.elements.folder.value,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()};const replacement=f.elements.replace.files?.[0];if(replacement){const out=await v42CompressImage(replacement);item.src=out.url;item.width=out.width;item.height=out.height;item.seed=false;item.name=replacement.name}list[idx]=item;v42MediaSave(list);cmsNotify('Image updated','Metadata and image changes have been saved locally.');render()}
window.v42SaveMedia=v42SaveMedia;
function v42ViewMedia(id){const item=v42MediaGet(id);if(!item)return;v42OpenDetail({title:item.title||item.name,category:item.folder||'Media Library',image:item.src,body:item.alt||item.name})}
window.v42ViewMedia=v42ViewMedia;
let V42_MEDIA_TARGET='';
function v42MediaPickerHtml(){const list=v42MediaLoad();return `<div id="v42-media-picker" class="v42-media-picker" onclick="if(event.target===this)v42CloseMediaPicker()"><div class="v42-media-picker-card"><div class="v42-media-picker-head"><h3>Choose an image</h3><button class="cms-detail-close" style="position:static" type="button" onclick="v42CloseMediaPicker()">×</button></div><div class="v42-media-picker-body"><div class="v42-picker-upload"><label class="btn red" style="cursor:pointer">UPLOAD NEW IMAGE<input type="file" accept="image/*" style="display:none" onchange="v42UploadMediaInput(this,true)"></label><a class="btn ghost" href="#admin-media" onclick="v42CloseMediaPicker()">OPEN MEDIA LIBRARY</a></div><div class="v42-picker-grid">${list.map(m=>`<button class="v42-picker-item" type="button" onclick="v42MediaUse('${m.id}')"><img src="${v42MediaSrc(m)}" alt="${cmsEscape(m.alt||m.title||m.name)}"><b>${cmsEscape(m.title||m.name)}</b></button>`).join('')}</div></div></div></div>`}
function v42OpenMediaPicker(fieldName){V42_MEDIA_TARGET=fieldName;v42CloseMediaPicker();document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',v42MediaPickerHtml())}
window.v42OpenMediaPicker=v42OpenMediaPicker;
function v42CloseMediaPicker(){document.getElementById('v42-media-picker')?.remove()}
window.v42CloseMediaPicker=v42CloseMediaPicker;
function v42MediaUse(id){const m=v42MediaGet(id),f=document.querySelector(`[name="${V42_MEDIA_TARGET}"]`);if(!m||!f)return;f.value=m.src;const p=document.getElementById('cms-media-preview-'+V42_MEDIA_TARGET);if(p)p.innerHTML=`<img src="${v42MediaSrc(m)}" alt="${cmsEscape(m.alt||m.title||m.name)}">`;v42CloseMediaPicker();cmsNotify('Image selected','This image will be used when the record is saved.')}
window.v42MediaUse=v42MediaUse;
function v42ClearMedia(fieldName){const f=document.querySelector(`[name="${fieldName}"]`);if(f)f.value='';const p=document.getElementById('cms-media-preview-'+fieldName);if(p)p.innerHTML='<span>No image selected</span>'}
window.v42ClearMedia=v42ClearMedia;

// Add image fields to each content manager exactly once.
function v42EnsureMediaFields(){const defs=[['news','image','Featured image'],['events','image','Event image'],['gradings','image','Grading image'],['schools','image','Venue image'],['instructors','photo','Profile image'],['committee','photo','Profile image']];defs.forEach(([type,name,label])=>{if(CMS_FIELDS[type]&&!CMS_FIELDS[type].some(f=>f.name===name))CMS_FIELDS[type].push({name,label,type:'media'})})}
v42EnsureMediaFields();
const _v41CmsFieldMarkup=cmsFieldMarkup;
cmsFieldMarkup=function(f){if(f.type!=='media')return _v41CmsFieldMarkup(f);return `<label class="cms-media-field">${f.label}<input class="cms-media-hidden" type="hidden" name="${f.name}"><div class="cms-media-picker-row"><div id="cms-media-preview-${f.name}" class="cms-media-form-preview"><span>No image selected</span></div><button class="btn ghost" type="button" onclick="v42OpenMediaPicker('${f.name}')">CHOOSE FROM MEDIA</button><button class="cms-small-btn" type="button" onclick="v42ClearMedia('${f.name}')">CLEAR</button></div></label>`};
const _v41CmsEditRecord=cmsEditRecord;
cmsEditRecord=function(type,id){_v41CmsEditRecord(type,id);const x=cmsRecord(type,id);if(!x)return;const field=type==='instructors'||type==='committee'?'photo':'image';const preview=document.getElementById('cms-media-preview-'+field);if(preview){const src=x[field];preview.innerHTML=src?`<img src="${resolveAssetPath(src)}" alt="Selected image">`:'<span>No image selected</span>'}};
window.cmsEditRecord=cmsEditRecord;
const _v41CmsClearForm=cmsClearForm;
cmsClearForm=function(type){_v41CmsClearForm(type);const field=type==='instructors'||type==='committee'?'photo':'image';const preview=document.getElementById('cms-media-preview-'+field);if(preview)preview.innerHTML='<span>No image selected</span>'};
window.cmsClearForm=cmsClearForm;

// Make admin record lists visibly image-aware.
cmsAdminManager=function(type,title,subtitle,fields){const list=cmsCollection(type);const rows=list.map(x=>{const src=x.image||x.photo||'';return `<article class="cms-record cms-record-v42"><div class="cms-record-thumb">${src?`<img src="${src}" alt="">`:'IMAGE'}</div><div><h4>${cmsEscape(x.title||x.name||x.school||'Untitled')}</h4><p>${cmsEscape(x.summary||x.desc||x.notes||x.address||x.role||'')}</p><div class="cms-record-meta"><span>${cmsEscape(x.status||'Live')}</span>${x.date?`<span>${cmsFmtDate(x.date)}</span>`:''}${x.category?`<span>${cmsEscape(x.category)}</span>`:''}${x.region?`<span>${cmsEscape(x.region)}</span>`:''}</div></div><div class="cms-record-actions"><button class="cms-small-btn" type="button" onclick="cmsEditRecord('${type}','${x.id}')">EDIT</button><button class="cms-small-btn danger" type="button" onclick="cmsDeleteRecord('${type}','${x.id}')">DELETE</button></div></article>`}).join('');const formFields=fields.map(f=>cmsFieldMarkup(f)).join('');return adminShell(type,'Live content','Manage '+subtitle,`${cmsLiveStrip()}<div class="cms-manager-grid"><section class="cms-list-card"><div class="cms-card-head"><div><div class="kicker">Current public data</div><h3>${title}</h3></div><span class="status-chip ok">${list.length} records</span></div><div class="cms-card-body"><div class="cms-list">${rows||'<div class="cms-empty">No records yet. Add the first one using the editor.</div>'}</div></div></section><aside class="cms-editor-card"><div class="cms-card-head"><div><div class="kicker">Add / edit</div><h3 id="cms-editor-title-${type}">New ${subtitle.replace(/s$/,'')}</h3></div><button class="cms-small-btn" type="button" onclick="cmsClearForm('${type}')">CLEAR</button></div><div class="cms-card-body"><form id="cms-form-${type}" class="cms-form" onsubmit="cmsSubmitForm(event,'${type}')"><input type="hidden" name="id">${formFields}<div class="cms-form-actions"><button class="btn red" type="submit">SAVE & PUBLISH</button><button class="btn ghost" type="button" onclick="cmsClearForm('${type}')">NEW ITEM</button></div></form><div class="cms-backup-box"><p>Changes and selected images are stored on this device and reflected on the website pages in this single-file build.</p></div></div></aside></div>`)};

routes['admin-media']=()=>{const list=v42MediaLoad(),selected=list[0];return adminShell('media','Media','Image library — full CRUD',`${cmsLiveStrip()}<section class="admin-panel"><div class="v42-media-top"><div><div class="kicker">Functional media library</div><h3 style="margin:4px 0">Upload, view, edit, replace and delete images</h3><p class="mini-copy">Uploaded images are resized and stored locally in this browser. They can be selected in News, Events, Gradings, Schools, Instructor and Committee editors.</p></div><label class="btn red" style="cursor:pointer">UPLOAD IMAGE<input type="file" accept="image/*" multiple style="display:none" onchange="v42UploadMediaInput(this,false)"></label></div><div class="v42-media-grid">${list.map(m=>`<article class="v42-media-card"><div class="v42-media-image"><img src="${v42MediaSrc(m)}" alt="${cmsEscape(m.alt||m.title||m.name)}"></div><div class="v42-media-copy"><h4>${cmsEscape(m.name)}</h4><p>${cmsEscape(m.folder||'Uploads')} ${m.width?`• ${m.width}×${m.height}`:''}${v42MediaBytes(m.src)?` • ${v42MediaBytes(m.src)} KB`:''}</p><div class="v42-media-actions"><button type="button" onclick="v42ViewMedia('${m.id}')">VIEW</button><button type="button" onclick="v42EditMedia('${m.id}')">EDIT / REPLACE</button><button class="danger" type="button" onclick="v42DeleteMedia('${m.id}')">DELETE</button></div></div></article>`).join('')}</div></section><section class="v42-media-editor"><div class="v42-media-editor-preview">${selected?`<img id="v42-media-editor-img" src="${v42MediaSrc(selected)}" alt="${cmsEscape(selected.alt||selected.title||selected.name)}">`:'<span>No media</span>'}</div><form id="v42-media-edit-form" class="v42-media-editor-form" onsubmit="v42SaveMedia(event)"><div class="kicker">Attachment details</div><h3 id="v42-media-editor-heading">${selected?'Editing '+cmsEscape(selected.name):'Select an image to edit'}</h3><input type="hidden" name="id" value="${selected?selected.id:''}"><label>File name<input name="name" value="${selected?cmsEscape(selected.name):''}"></label><label>Title<input name="title" value="${selected?cmsEscape(selected.title||''):''}"></label><label>Alternative text<input name="alt" value="${selected?cmsEscape(selected.alt||''):''}"></label><label>Folder<select name="folder">${['Uploads','News & Events','Instructor Photos','Committee','School Locations','Programmes'].map(o=>`<option ${selected&&selected.folder===o?'selected':''}>${o}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>Replace image<input name="replace" type="file" accept="image/*"></label><div class="admin-actions-row"><button class="btn red" type="submit">SAVE CHANGES</button>${selected?`<button class="btn dark" type="button" onclick="v42DeleteMedia('${selected.id}')">DELETE IMAGE</button>`:''}</div></form></section>`)};

// Media-aware public content.
cmsCombinedEvents=function(){const ev=cmsCollection('events').filter(x=>String(x.status).toLowerCase()==='published').map(x=>({...x,_type:'events'}));const gr=cmsCollection('gradings').filter(x=>!['draft','closed'].includes(String(x.status).toLowerCase())).map(x=>({id:x.id,title:x.title,category:'Grading • '+(x.region||'WJO'),status:'Published',date:x.date,venue:x.venue,location:x.region||'',desc:x.notes||'',image:x.image||'',_type:'gradings',seed:x.seed}));return [...ev,...gr].sort((a,b)=>String(a.date).localeCompare(String(b.date)))};
cmsSchoolCard=function(x){const image=x.image?`<div class="cms-school-image"><img src="${x.image}" alt="${cmsEscape(x.name)}"></div>`:'';return `<article class="cms-school-card ${x.seed?'':'cms-public-added'}" style="position:relative">${image}<div class="kicker">${cmsEscape(x.region||'WJO')}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.name)}</h3><p>${cmsEscape(x.address||'')}<br><b>${cmsEscape(x.town||'')}</b> ${cmsEscape(x.postcode||'')}</p><div class="cms-school-tags">${(x.programmes||[]).map(p=>`<span>${cmsEscape(p)}</span>`).join('')}${(x.days||[]).map(p=>`<span>${cmsEscape(p)}</span>`).join('')}</div></article>`};

// Include the local media library in JSON backup/import.
cmsExportData=function(){const pkg={version:44,exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(),content:cmsData(),media:v42MediaLoad()};const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='wjo-content-backup-v59.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);cmsNotify('Backup created','Content and media library metadata/images were exported together.')};
window.cmsExportData=cmsExportData;
cmsImportDataInput=function(input){const f=input.files?.[0];if(!f)return;const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{try{const pkg=JSON.parse(r.result);const content=pkg.content||pkg;if(!content||!content.news||!content.events)throw new Error('Invalid file');content.version=WJO_CMS_VERSION;cmsSaveData(content);if(Array.isArray(pkg.media))v42MediaSave(pkg.media);cmsNotify('Backup imported','Content and media have been restored to the local content store.');render()}catch(e){alert('That file is not a valid WJO content backup.')}};r.readAsText(f)};
window.cmsImportDataInput=cmsImportDataInput;
// ======================= END V42 =======================

// ======================= V43 — RESTORE SCHOOL + ARTICLE DETAILS =======================
function v43NewsFallbackBody(x){
  const seed=(cmsSeedData().news||[]).find(n=>n.id===x.id);
  if(seed&&seed.body)return seed.body;
  const summary=x.summary||'';
  return `${summary}\n\nThis article was added through the WJO front-end content manager.\n\nThe article page can include a featured image, author, publication date and links to related WJO content.`;
}
function v43ArticleParagraphs(text){
  return String(text||'').split(/\n\s*\n/).filter(Boolean).map(p=>`<p>${cmsEscape(p).replace(/\n/g,'<br>')}</p>`).join('');
}
routes.article=()=>{
  const id=hashParams().get('id');
  let x=id?cmsRecord('news',id):null;
  if(!x){x=cmsCollection('news').filter(n=>String(n.status).toLowerCase()==='published')[0]||null}
  if(!x)return shell(`<main>${pageHero('WJO <em>NEWS.</em>','Article','This article could not be found.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="v43-article-wrap"><a class="btn red" href="#news">BACK TO NEWS</a></div></section></main>`);
  const image=x.image?resolveAssetPath(x.image):'';
  const body=x.body||v43NewsFallbackBody(x);
  return shell(`<main>${pageHero(cmsEscape(x.title).toUpperCase(),'WJO News',cmsEscape(x.summary||''))}<section class="page-section"><article class="v43-article-wrap">${image?`<img class="v43-article-cover" src="${image}" alt="${cmsEscape(x.title)}">`:''}<div class="v43-article-meta"><span>${cmsEscape(x.category||'WJO News')}</span>${x.date?`<span>${cmsFmtDate(x.date)}</span>`:''}${x.author?`<span>${cmsEscape(x.author)}</span>`:''}</div><div class="v43-article-body">${v43ArticleParagraphs(body)}</div><div class="v43-article-actions"><a class="btn red" href="#news">BACK TO NEWS</a><a class="btn ghost" href="#find-school">FIND A CLASS</a></div></article></section></main>`)
};

cmsShowNews=function(id){location.hash='#article?id='+encodeURIComponent(id)};
window.cmsShowNews=cmsShowNews;
cmsNewsCard=function(x){
  const image=resolveAssetPath(x.image||'assets/news-newsletter.jpg');
  const cls=x.seed?'':' cms-public-added';
  return `<a class="news-card cms-clickable-news${cls}" style="--newsbg:url('${image}');position:relative" href="#article?id=${encodeURIComponent(x.id)}" aria-label="Read ${cmsEscape(x.title)}"><div class="tag">${cmsEscape(x.category||'WJO News')}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.title)}</h3><p style="color:#d3d7de">${cmsEscape(x.summary||'')}</p><div class="cms-record-meta"><span>${cmsFmtDate(x.date)}</span><span>${cmsEscape(x.author||'WJO')}</span></div><span class="chip-soft" style="margin-top:12px">READ FULL ARTICLE →</span></a>`
};

cmsSchoolCard=function(x){
  const image=x.image?`<div class="cms-school-image"><img src="${resolveAssetPath(x.image)}" alt="${cmsEscape(x.name)}"></div>`:'';
  return `<a class="cms-school-card-link" href="#school?id=${encodeURIComponent(x.id)}" aria-label="View ${cmsEscape(x.name)} details"><article class="cms-school-card ${x.seed?'':'cms-public-added'}" style="position:relative">${image}<div class="kicker">${cmsEscape(x.region||'WJO')}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.name)}</h3><p>${cmsEscape(x.address||'')}<br><b>${cmsEscape(x.town||'')}</b> ${cmsEscape(x.postcode||'')}</p><div class="cms-school-tags">${(x.programmes||[]).map(p=>`<span>${cmsEscape(p)}</span>`).join('')}${(x.days||[]).map(p=>`<span>${cmsEscape(p)}</span>`).join('')}</div><span class="cms-school-view">VIEW SCHOOL →</span></article></a>`
};

routes.school=()=>{
  const id=hashParams().get('id');
  const live=cmsCollection('schools').filter(x=>String(x.status).toLowerCase()==='live');
  const x=(id?cmsRecord('schools',id):null)||live[0];
  if(!x)return shell(`<main>${pageHero('FIND YOUR <em>WJO.</em>','School details','This school could not be found.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><a class="btn red" href="#find-school">BACK TO SCHOOL FINDER</a></div></section></main>`);
  const sessions=Array.isArray(x.sessions)?x.sessions:[];
  const schedule=sessions.length?sessions.map(row=>`<tr><td><b>${cmsEscape(row[0]||'')}</b></td><td><b>${cmsEscape(row[1]||'')}</b></td><td>${cmsEscape(row[2]||'')}</td><td>${cmsEscape(row[3]||'')}</td><td><a class="btn dark" href="#contact">BOOK</a></td></tr>`).join(''):`<tr><td colspan="5">Please contact WJO for the current class timetable at this venue.</td></tr>`;
  const programmes=Array.isArray(x.programmes)?x.programmes:[];
  const days=Array.isArray(x.days)?x.days:[];
  const progs=programmes.length?programmes.join(' • '):'Contact WJO for current programme details';
  const dayText=days.length?days.join(' / '):'Contact WJO for current training days';
  const maps='https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query='+encodeURIComponent(x.address||[x.town,x.postcode].filter(Boolean).join(' '));
  const image=x.image?resolveAssetPath(x.image):'';
  const fallbackBg=typeof schoolBgPath==='function'?schoolBgPath(x):'';
  const finalImg=image||resolveAssetPath(fallbackBg||'');
  const venuePanel=finalImg?`<div class="v43-school-hero-image"><img src="${finalImg}" alt="${cmsEscape(x.name)}"></div>`:`<div class="school-detail-map"><div><div class="kicker">${cmsEscape(x.region||'WJO')}</div><strong>${cmsEscape(x.town||x.name)}</strong><span>${cmsEscape(x.postcode||'')}</span></div></div>`;
  return shell(`<main>${pageHero(`JADO KUIN DO <em>${cmsEscape(String(x.town||x.name).toUpperCase())}.</em>`,'Local academy',`${cmsEscape(x.name)} • ${cmsEscape(x.region||'WJO')}`)}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap grid-2"><div><div class="kicker">Your local WJO academy</div><h2 style="font-size:47px;line-height:1">${cmsEscape(x.name)}</h2><p style="color:#aeb3bc">${cmsEscape(x.address||[x.town,x.postcode].filter(Boolean).join(', '))}</p><div class="school-meta">${programmes.map(p=>`<span class="pill">${cmsEscape(p)}</span>`).join('')}<span class="pill">${cmsEscape(dayText)}</span></div><div class="hero-actions"><a class="btn red" href="#contact">BOOK FREE TASTER</a><a class="btn ghost" href="${maps}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">GET DIRECTIONS ↗</a><a class="btn ghost" href="#find-school">ALL SCHOOLS</a></div></div>${venuePanel}</div></section><section class="page-section cream"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-header"><div><div class="kicker">Weekly timetable</div><h2>Choose your class.</h2></div></div><div style="overflow:auto"><table class="timetable">${schedule}</table></div></div></section><section class="page-section"><div class="wrap grid-3"><div class="content-card"><h3>What to bring</h3><p>Comfortable sports clothing and water. No uniform is needed for a taster session.</p></div><div class="content-card"><h3>Programmes</h3><p>${cmsEscape(progs)}</p></div><div class="content-card"><h3>Questions?</h3><p>Contact WJO before your visit if you need help choosing the right class.</p></div></div></section></main>`)
};

// Make sure older locally stored V42 records gain a usable full article body after migration.
(function v43HydrateNewsBodies(){
  const d=cmsData();let changed=false;const seeds=cmsSeedData();const map=Object.fromEntries(seeds.news.map(n=>[n.id,n.body||'']));
  d.news=(d.news||[]).map(n=>{if(!n.body){changed=true;return {...n,body:map[n.id]||n.summary||''}}return n});
  if(changed)cmsSaveData(d)
})();

// ======================= V45 — COMPLETE MEDIA LIBRARY + IMAGE MIGRATION =======================
const V45_MEDIA_KEY='wjo-v45-media-library';
function v45PrettyAssetName(path){return String(path||'').replace(/^assets\//,'').replace(/\.[^.]+$/,'').replace(/[-_]+/g,' ').replace(/\b\w/g,c=>c.toUpperCase())}
function v45FolderForAsset(path){const p=String(path||'').toLowerCase();if(p.includes('venue-'))return 'School Locations';if(p.includes('event-')||p.includes('news-'))return 'News & Events';if(p.includes('instructor-nicola'))return 'Committee';if(p.includes('instructor-'))return 'Instructor Photos';if(p.includes('shop-'))return 'Shop';if(p.includes('wjo-logo')||p.includes('wjo-crest'))return 'Branding';if(p.includes('mascot-')||p.includes('superj-')||p.includes('program-')||p.includes('adults-')||p.includes('tile-')||p.includes('value-')||p.includes('hero-'))return 'Programmes';return 'Site Images'}
function v45BuiltInMediaSeed(){const items=Object.keys(WJO_EMBEDDED_ASSETS).filter(k=>/\.(?:png|jpe?g|webp)$/i.test(k)).map((src,i)=>({id:'v45-'+cmsSlug(src),name:src.split('/').pop(),title:v45PrettyAssetName(src),alt:v45PrettyAssetName(src),folder:v45FolderForAsset(src),src,seed:true,builtin:true,createdAt:'2026-09-06T00:00:00.000Z'}));if(typeof V42_MOVEMENT_IMAGE==='string'&&!items.some(x=>x.src===V42_MOVEMENT_IMAGE))items.push({id:'v45-movement',name:'jado-movement-sequence.png',title:'Jado Movement Sequence',alt:'Jado movement sequence illustration',folder:'Programmes',src:V42_MOVEMENT_IMAGE,seed:true,builtin:true,createdAt:'2026-09-06T00:00:00.000Z'});return items}
const _v44MediaLoad=v42MediaLoad;
const _v44MediaSave=v42MediaSave;
v42MediaSeed=function(){return v45BuiltInMediaSeed()};
v42MediaLoad=function(){let existing=[];try{const v45=localStorage.getItem(V45_MEDIA_KEY);if(v45)existing=JSON.parse(v45)||[]}catch(e){}if(!Array.isArray(existing)||!existing.length){try{const old=localStorage.getItem(V42_MEDIA_KEY);if(old)existing=JSON.parse(old)||[]}catch(e){}}if(!Array.isArray(existing))existing=[];const seeds=v45BuiltInMediaSeed();const bySrc=new Set(existing.map(x=>x.src));for(const seed of seeds){if(!bySrc.has(seed.src)){existing.push(seed);bySrc.add(seed.src)}}try{localStorage.setItem(V45_MEDIA_KEY,JSON.stringify(existing))}catch(e){}return existing};
v42MediaSave=function(list){try{localStorage.setItem(V45_MEDIA_KEY,JSON.stringify(list));localStorage.setItem(V42_MEDIA_KEY,JSON.stringify(list))}catch(e){cmsNotify('Storage warning','The browser storage is full; export a backup before adding more large images.')}return list};
window.v42MediaLoad=v42MediaLoad;window.v42MediaSave=v42MediaSave;

function v45SchoolImageFor(id){return ({
 'stantonbury':'assets/venue-real-stantonbury.png',
 'bushfield':'assets/venue-school-bushfield.jpg',
 'daventry':'assets/venue-real-daventry.png',
 'brackley-leisure':'assets/venue-real-brackley.png',
 'towcester':'assets/venue-real-towcester.png'
})[id]||''}
function v45GradingImageFor(id){return ({
 'grading-regional-day':'assets/event-levels.jpg',
 'grading-junior-awards':'assets/event-junior-black.jpg',
 'grading-black-belt-prep':'assets/event-adult-degree.jpg'
})[id]||''}
function v45HydrateContentImages(){const d=cmsData();let changed=false;d.schools=(d.schools||[]).map(x=>{const img=v45SchoolImageFor(x.id);if(!x.image&&img){changed=true;return {...x,image:img}}return x});d.gradings=(d.gradings||[]).map(x=>{const img=v45GradingImageFor(x.id);if(!x.image&&img){changed=true;return {...x,image:img}}return x});if(changed)cmsSaveData(d);return d}
v45HydrateContentImages();

function v45AdminThumb(type,x){const src=x.image||x.photo||'';if(src)return `<div class="cms-record-thumb"><img src="${resolveAssetPath(src)}" alt="${cmsEscape(x.title||x.name||'Image')}"></div>`;const label=type==='schools'?'NO VENUE IMAGE':type==='gradings'?'NO GRADING IMAGE':'NO IMAGE';return `<div class="cms-record-thumb v45-no-image"><div><img src="${V38_LOGO}" alt=""><span>${label}</span></div></div>`}
cmsAdminManager=function(type,title,subtitle,fields){const list=cmsCollection(type);const rows=list.map(x=>`<article class="cms-record cms-record-v42">${v45AdminThumb(type,x)}<div><h4>${cmsEscape(x.title||x.name||x.school||'Untitled')}</h4><p>${cmsEscape(x.summary||x.desc||x.notes||x.address||x.role||'')}</p><div class="cms-record-meta"><span>${cmsEscape(x.status||'Live')}</span>${x.date?`<span>${cmsFmtDate(x.date)}</span>`:''}${x.category?`<span>${cmsEscape(x.category)}</span>`:''}${x.region?`<span>${cmsEscape(x.region)}</span>`:''}</div>${(x.image||x.photo)?'<span class="v45-linked-badge">Image linked</span>':''}</div><div class="cms-record-actions"><button class="cms-small-btn" type="button" onclick="cmsEditRecord('${type}','${x.id}')">EDIT</button><button class="cms-small-btn danger" type="button" onclick="cmsDeleteRecord('${type}','${x.id}')">DELETE</button></div></article>`).join('');const formFields=fields.map(f=>cmsFieldMarkup(f)).join('');return adminShell(type,'Live content','Manage '+subtitle,`${cmsLiveStrip()}<div class="cms-manager-grid"><section class="cms-list-card"><div class="cms-card-head"><div><div class="kicker">Current public data</div><h3>${title}</h3></div><span class="status-chip ok">${list.length} records</span></div><div class="cms-card-body"><div class="cms-list">${rows||'<div class="cms-empty">No records yet. Add the first one using the editor.</div>'}</div></div></section><aside class="cms-editor-card"><div class="cms-card-head"><div><div class="kicker">Add / edit</div><h3 id="cms-editor-title-${type}">New ${subtitle.replace(/s$/,'')}</h3></div><button class="cms-small-btn" type="button" onclick="cmsClearForm('${type}')">CLEAR</button></div><div class="cms-card-body"><form id="cms-form-${type}" class="cms-form" onsubmit="cmsSubmitForm(event,'${type}')"><input type="hidden" name="id">${formFields}<div class="cms-form-actions"><button class="btn red" type="submit">SAVE & PUBLISH</button><button class="btn ghost" type="button" onclick="cmsClearForm('${type}')">NEW ITEM</button></div></form><div class="cms-backup-box"><p>Changes and selected images are stored on this device and reflected on the website pages in this single-file build.</p></div></div></aside></div>`)};

const _v44CmsEditRecord=cmsEditRecord;
cmsEditRecord=function(type,id){_v44CmsEditRecord(type,id);const x=cmsRecord(type,id);if(!x)return;const field=type==='instructors'||type==='committee'?'photo':'image';const p=document.getElementById('cms-media-preview-'+field);if(!p)return;const src=x[field]||'';if(src){p.classList.remove('v45-no-image');p.innerHTML=`<img src="${resolveAssetPath(src)}" alt="Selected image">`}else{p.classList.add('v45-no-image');p.innerHTML=`<img src="${V38_LOGO}" alt=""><span>No ${type==='schools'?'venue ':type==='gradings'?'grading ':''}image selected</span>`}};

window.cmsClearForm=cmsClearForm;

function v45FilterMedia(){const q=(document.getElementById('v45-media-search')?.value||'').toLowerCase().trim();const folder=document.getElementById('v45-media-folder')?.value||'all';let shown=0;document.querySelectorAll('.v42-media-card[data-v45-media]').forEach(card=>{const okQ=!q||card.dataset.v45Search.includes(q);const okF=folder==='all'||card.dataset.v45Folder===folder;const hide=!(okQ&&okF);card.dataset.v45Hidden=hide?'1':'0';if(!hide)shown++});const c=document.getElementById('v45-media-visible-count');if(c)c.textContent=shown+' shown';const e=document.getElementById('v45-media-empty');if(e)e.style.display=shown?'none':'block'}
window.v45FilterMedia=v45FilterMedia;
routes['admin-media']=()=>{const list=v42MediaLoad(),selected=list[0];const folders=['all',...new Set(list.map(m=>m.folder||'Uploads'))];return adminShell('media','Media','Image library — all website images',`${cmsLiveStrip()}<section class="admin-panel"><div class="v42-media-top"><div><div class="kicker">Complete media library</div><h3 style="margin:4px 0">All <span class="v45-media-total">${list.length}</span> images available</h3><p class="mini-copy">The media library indexes every image embedded in the website, not just the original seed items. These images can be selected in News, Events, Gradings, Schools, Instructor and Committee editors.</p></div><label class="btn red" style="cursor:pointer">UPLOAD IMAGE<input type="file" accept="image/*" multiple style="display:none" onchange="v42UploadMediaInput(this,false)"></label></div><div class="v45-media-note">Built-in website artwork is visible here alongside images uploaded through Admin. Existing uploads are retained and merged into this library.</div><div class="v45-media-toolbar"><input id="v45-media-search" class="field" placeholder="Search images…" oninput="v45FilterMedia()"><select id="v45-media-folder" class="field" onchange="v45FilterMedia()">${folders.map(f=>`<option value="${cmsEscape(f)}">${f==='all'?'All folders':cmsEscape(f)}</option>`).join('')}</select><div id="v45-media-visible-count" class="v45-media-count">${list.length} shown</div></div><div class="v42-media-grid">${list.map(m=>`<article class="v42-media-card" data-v45-media="1" data-v45-folder="${cmsEscape(m.folder||'Uploads')}" data-v45-search="${cmsEscape(((m.name||'')+' '+(m.title||'')+' '+(m.alt||'')+' '+(m.folder||'')).toLowerCase())}"><div class="v42-media-image"><img src="${v42MediaSrc(m)}" alt="${cmsEscape(m.alt||m.title||m.name)}"></div><div class="v42-media-copy"><h4>${cmsEscape(m.name)}</h4><p>${cmsEscape(m.folder||'Uploads')} ${m.width?`• ${m.width}×${m.height}`:''}${v42MediaBytes(m.src)?` • ${v42MediaBytes(m.src)} KB`:''}</p><div class="v42-media-actions"><button type="button" onclick="v42ViewMedia('${m.id}')">VIEW</button><button type="button" onclick="v42EditMedia('${m.id}')">EDIT / REPLACE</button><button class="danger" type="button" onclick="v42DeleteMedia('${m.id}')">DELETE</button></div></div></article>`).join('')}</div><div id="v45-media-empty" class="v45-media-empty">No images match that search or folder.</div></section><section class="v42-media-editor"><div class="v42-media-editor-preview">${selected?`<img id="v42-media-editor-img" src="${v42MediaSrc(selected)}" alt="${cmsEscape(selected.alt||selected.title||selected.name)}">`:'<span>No media</span>'}</div><form id="v42-media-edit-form" class="v42-media-editor-form" onsubmit="v42SaveMedia(event)"><div class="kicker">Attachment details</div><h3 id="v42-media-editor-heading">${selected?'Editing '+cmsEscape(selected.name):'Select an image to edit'}</h3><input type="hidden" name="id" value="${selected?selected.id:''}"><label>File name<input name="name" value="${selected?cmsEscape(selected.name):''}"></label><label>Title<input name="title" value="${selected?cmsEscape(selected.title||''):''}"></label><label>Alternative text<input name="alt" value="${selected?cmsEscape(selected.alt||''):''}"></label><label>Folder<select name="folder">${['Uploads','News & Events','Instructor Photos','Committee','School Locations','Programmes','Shop','Branding','Site Images'].map(o=>`<option ${selected&&selected.folder===o?'selected':''}>${o}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>Replace image<input name="replace" type="file" accept="image/*"></label><div class="admin-actions-row"><button class="btn red" type="submit">SAVE CHANGES</button>${selected?`<button class="btn dark" type="button" onclick="v42DeleteMedia('${selected.id}')">DELETE // V45 backup name/version while remaining compatible with V44 content data.
cmsExportData=function(){const pkg={version:45,exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(),content:cmsData(),media:v42MediaLoad()};const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='wjo-content-backup-v59.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);cmsNotify('Backup created','V45 content and the complete media library were exported together.')};
window.cmsExportData=cmsExportData;
cmsImportDataInput=function(input){const f=input.files?.[0];if(!f)return;const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{try{const pkg=JSON.parse(r.result);const content=pkg.content||pkg;if(!content||!content.news||!content.events)throw new Error('Invalid file');content.version=WJO_CMS_VERSION;cmsSaveData(content);if(Array.isArray(pkg.media))v42MediaSave(pkg.media);v45HydrateContentImages();cmsNotify('Backup imported','Content and media have been restored and upgraded for V45.');render()}catch(e){alert('That file is not a valid WJO content backup.')}};r.readAsText(f)};
window.cmsImportDataInput=cmsImportDataInput;
// ======================= END V45 =======================


// ======================= V46 — FUNCTIONAL ADMIN CALENDAR =======================
const V46_CAL_STATE=window.V46_CAL_STATE||{view:'month',month:'',category:'all',region:'all',status:'all',search:'',weekStart:''};
window.V46_CAL_STATE=V46_CAL_STATE;
function v46Pad(n){return String(n).padStart(2,'0')}
function v46ISO(d){return `${d.getFullYear()}-${v46Pad(d.getMonth()+1)}-${v46Pad(d.getDate())}`}
function v46Today(){const d=new Date();return v46ISO(d)}
function v46MonthKey(d){return `${d.getFullYear()}-${v46Pad(d.getMonth()+1)}`}
function v46DateFromMonth(m){const [y,mo]=String(m).split('-').map(Number);return new Date(y,mo-1,1,12)}
function v46AddMonths(m,delta){const d=v46DateFromMonth(m);d.setMonth(d.getMonth()+delta);return v46MonthKey(d)}
function v46Monday(date){const d=new Date(date+'T12:00:00');const day=(d.getDay()+6)%7;d.setDate(d.getDate()-day);return v46ISO(d)}
function v46AddDays(iso,n){const d=new Date(iso+'T12:00:00');d.setDate(d.getDate()+n);return v46ISO(d)}
function v46InferRegion(text){const t=String(text||'').toLowerCase();const regions=['Northamptonshire','Oxfordshire','Warwickshire','Hertfordshire','Leicestershire','Buckinghamshire','Scotland','Highlands'];for(const r of regions)if(t.includes(r.toLowerCase()))return r;return 'WJO-wide'}
function v46Group(item){const t=((item.category||'')+' '+(item.title||'')+' '+(item.recordType||'')).toLowerCase();if(item.recordType==='grading'||/grading|black belt|belt promotion|degree/.test(t))return 'Gradings';if(/seminar|workshop|training day/.test(t))return 'Seminars';if(/meeting|committee|call/.test(t))return 'Meetings';if(/news|reminder|newsletter|publish|website/.test(t))return 'News / reminders';return 'Events'}
function v46ClassForGroup(g){return g==='Gradings'?'grade':g==='Seminars'?'seminar':g==='Meetings'?'meeting':g==='News / reminders'?'news':'event'}
function v46AdminCalendarItems(){const ev=cmsCollection('events').map(x=>({id:x.id,source:'events',recordType:'event',title:x.title||'',date:x.date||'',start_time:x.start_time||'',end_time:x.end_time||'',category:x.category||'Event',region:x.region||v46InferRegion((x.location||'')+' '+(x.venue||'')),venue:x.venue||'',location:x.location||'',status:x.status||'Published',description:x.desc||x.summary||'',image:x.image||'',seed:x.seed}));const gr=cmsCollection('gradings').map(x=>({id:x.id,source:'gradings',recordType:'grading',title:x.title||'',date:x.date||'',start_time:x.start_time||'',end_time:x.end_time||'',category:'Grading',region:x.region||'WJO-wide',venue:x.venue||'',location:x.location||x.region||'',status:x.status||'Open',description:x.notes||'',image:x.image||'',seed:x.seed}));return [...ev,...gr].map(x=>({...x,group:v46Group(x)})).filter(x=>/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(x.date)).sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date)||a.title.localeCompare(b.title))}
function v46EnsureCalendarState(){const items=v46AdminCalendarItems(),today=v46Today();if(!V46_CAL_STATE.month){const future=items.find(x=>x.date>=today);V46_CAL_STATE.month=(future?future.date.slice(0,7):today.slice(0,7))}if(!V46_CAL_STATE.weekStart){const base=V46_CAL_STATE.month===today.slice(0,7)?today:V46_CAL_STATE.month+'-01';V46_CAL_STATE.weekStart=v46Monday(base)}}
function v46CalendarMonths(items){const months=new Set(items.map(x=>x.date.slice(0,7)));const today=v46Today().slice(0,7);for(let i=-3;i<=12;i++)months.add(v46AddMonths(today,i));return [...months].sort()}
function v46MonthLabel(m){return v46DateFromMonth(m).toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{month:'long',year:'numeric'})}
function v46StatusValues(items){return [...new Set(items.map(x=>x.status).filter(Boolean))].sort()}
function v46FilteredItems(opts={}){const items=v46AdminCalendarItems(),q=String(V46_CAL_STATE.search||'').toLowerCase().trim();return items.filter(x=>{if(!opts.ignoreMonth&&V46_CAL_STATE.month&&x.date.slice(0,7)!==V46_CAL_STATE.month)return false;if(V46_CAL_STATE.category!=='all'&&x.group!==V46_CAL_STATE.category)return false;if(V46_CAL_STATE.region!=='all'&&x.region!==V46_CAL_STATE.region)return false;if(V46_CAL_STATE.status!=='all'&&x.status!==V46_CAL_STATE.status)return false;if(q&&!((x.title+' '+x.category+' '+x.region+' '+x.venue+' '+x.location+' '+x.description).toLowerCase().includes(q)))return false;return true})}
function v46ApplyCalendarFilters(){V46_CAL_STATE.month=document.getElementById('v46-cal-month')?.value||V46_CAL_STATE.month;V46_CAL_STATE.category=document.getElementById('v46-cal-category')?.value||'all';V46_CAL_STATE.region=document.getElementById('v46-cal-region')?.value||'all';V46_CAL_STATE.status=document.getElementById('v46-cal-status')?.value||'all';V46_CAL_STATE.search=document.getElementById('v46-cal-search')?.value||'';V46_CAL_STATE.weekStart=v46Monday(V46_CAL_STATE.month+'-01');render()}
window.v46ApplyCalendarFilters=v46ApplyCalendarFilters;
function v46ResetCalendarFilters(){V46_CAL_STATE.category='all';V46_CAL_STATE.region='all';V46_CAL_STATE.status='all';V46_CAL_STATE.search='';render()}
window.v46ResetCalendarFilters=v46ResetCalendarFilters;
function v46SetCalendarView(v){V46_CAL_STATE.view=v;render()}
window.v46SetCalendarView=v46SetCalendarView;
function v46NavigateMonth(delta){V46_CAL_STATE.month=v46AddMonths(V46_CAL_STATE.month,delta);V46_CAL_STATE.weekStart=v46Monday(V46_CAL_STATE.month+'-01');render()}
window.v46NavigateMonth=v46NavigateMonth;
function v46CalendarToday(){const t=v46Today();V46_CAL_STATE.month=t.slice(0,7);V46_CAL_STATE.weekStart=v46Monday(t);render()}
window.v46CalendarToday=v46CalendarToday;
function v46NavigateWeek(delta){V46_CAL_STATE.weekStart=v46AddDays(V46_CAL_STATE.weekStart,delta*7);V46_CAL_STATE.month=V46_CAL_STATE.weekStart.slice(0,7);render()}
window.v46NavigateWeek=v46NavigateWeek;
function v46CalChip(x){const time=x.start_time?` • ${cmsEscape(x.start_time)}`:'';return `<button class="v46-event-chip ${v46ClassForGroup(x.group)}" type="button" onclick="v46OpenEventEditor('${x.source}','${x.id}')" title="Edit ${cmsEscape(x.title)}"><b>${cmsEscape(x.title)}</b><small>${cmsEscape(x.venue||x.region)}${time}</small></button>`}
function v46MonthView(items){const d=v46DateFromMonth(V46_CAL_STATE.month),y=d.getFullYear(),m=d.getMonth(),first=new Date(y,m,1,12),start=(first.getDay()+6)%7,startDate=new Date(y,m,1-start,12),today=v46Today();let cells='';for(let i=0;i<42;i++){const cur=new Date(startDate);cur.setDate(startDate.getDate()+i);const iso=v46ISO(cur),outside=cur.getMonth()!==m,dayItems=items.filter(x=>x.date===iso);cells+=`<div class="v46-day ${outside?'outside':''} ${iso===today?'today':''}"><div class="v46-day-number"><span>${cur.getDate()}${outside?' '+cur.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{month:'short'}):''}</span>${iso===today?'<small>Today</small>':''}</div>${dayItems.map(v46CalChip).join('')}</div>`}return `<div class="v46-cal-toolbar"><div><h3>${v46MonthLabel(V46_CAL_STATE.month)}</h3><p>${items.length} matching record${items.length===1?'':'s'} in this month</p></div><div class="v46-cal-nav"><button type="button" onclick="v46NavigateMonth(-1)">PREVIOUS</button><button type="button" onclick="v46CalendarToday()">TODAY</button><button type="button" onclick="v46NavigateMonth(1)">NEXT</button></div></div><div class="v46-cal-month-scroll"><div class="v46-month-grid">${['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'].map(x=>`<div class="v46-cal-weekday">${x}</div>`).join('')}${cells}</div></div>`}
function v46WeekView(allFiltered){const start=V46_CAL_STATE.weekStart||v46Monday(V46_CAL_STATE.month+'-01'),end=v46AddDays(start,6),items=allFiltered.filter(x=>x.date>=start&&x.date<=end);let days='';for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const iso=v46AddDays(start,i),d=new Date(iso+'T12:00:00'),di=items.filter(x=>x.date===iso);days+=`<section class="v46-week-day"><div class="v46-week-day-head"><b>${d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{weekday:'long'})}</b><span>${d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'numeric',month:'short'})}</span></div><div class="v46-week-events">${di.length?di.map(v46CalChip).join(''):'<span style="color:#727c88;font-size:11px">No matching items</span>'}</div></section>`}return `<div class="v46-cal-toolbar"><div><h3>Week commencing ${new Date(start+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'})}</h3><p>${items.length} matching record${items.length===1?'':'s'} this week</p></div><div class="v46-cal-nav"><button type="button" onclick="v46NavigateWeek(-1)">PREVIOUS</button><button type="button" onclick="v46CalendarToday()">TODAY</button><button type="button" onclick="v46NavigateWeek(1)">NEXT</button></div></div><div class="v46-week-grid">${days}</div>`}
function v46ListView(items){if(!items.length)return `<div class="v46-cal-toolbar"><div><h3>Upcoming list</h3><p>No records match the current filters.</p></div></div><div class="v46-cal-empty">Try changing the month or resetting the filters.</div>`;return `<div class="v46-cal-toolbar"><div><h3>Upcoming list — ${v46MonthLabel(V46_CAL_STATE.month)}</h3><p>${items.length} matching record${items.length===1?'':'s'}</p></div><div class="v46-cal-nav"><button type="button" onclick="v46ExportMonthCSV()">EXPORT MONTH</button></div></div><div class="v46-list">${items.map(x=>{const d=new Date(x.date+'T12:00:00');return `<article class="v46-list-row"><div class="v46-list-date"><b>${v46Pad(d.getDate())}</b><span>${d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{month:'short'}).toUpperCase()}</span></div><div class="v46-list-copy"><div class="kicker">${cmsEscape(x.group)} • ${cmsEscape(x.region)}</div><h4>${cmsEscape(x.title)}</h4><p>${cmsEscape(x.description||'No description supplied.')}</p><div class="v46-list-meta"><span>${cmsEscape(x.status)}</span><span>${cmsEscape(x.venue||'Venue TBC')}</span>${x.start_time?`<span>${cmsEscape(x.start_time)}${x.end_time?' – '+cmsEscape(x.end_time):''}</span>`:''}</div></div><div class="v46-list-actions"><button type="button" onclick="v46OpenEventEditor('${x.source}','${x.id}')">EDIT</button><button type="button" onclick="location.hash='#events'">PUBLIC VIEW</button><button class="danger" type="button" onclick="v46DeleteCalendarItem('${x.source}','${x.id}')">DELETE</button></div></article>`}).join('')}</div>`}
function v46CalendarWorkspace(){const monthItems=v46FilteredItems(),allFilters=v46FilteredItems({ignoreMonth:true});if(V46_CAL_STATE.view==='week')return v46WeekView(allFilters);if(V46_CAL_STATE.view==='list')return v46ListView(monthItems);return v46MonthView(monthItems)}
function v46MediaOptions(selected){let list=[];try{list=v42MediaLoad()}catch(e){}return `<option value="">No image</option>${list.map(m=>`<option value="${cmsEscape(m.src||'')}" ${selected===(m.src||'')?'selected':''}>${cmsEscape(m.name||m.title||'Image')}</option>`).join('')}`}

type=x?.recordType||'event',status=x?.status||(type==='grading'?'Open':'Published');let modal=document.getElementById('v46-event-modal');if(modal)modal.remove();modal=document.createElement('div');modal.id='v46-event-modal';modal.className='v46-modal-backdrop open';modal.innerHTML=`<div function v46UpdateEditorImagePreview(src){const p=document.getElementById('v46-editor-image-preview');if(!p)return;p.innerHTML=src?`<img src="${resolveAssetPath(src)}" alt="Selected image">`:'<span>No image selected</span>'}
window.v46UpdateEditorImagePreview=v46UpdateEditorImagePreview;
function v46CloseModal(id){document.getElementById(id)?.remove();document.body.style.overflow=''}
window.v46CloseModal=v46CloseModal;
function v46SaveCalendarItem(e){e.preventDefault();const f=e.currentTarget,fd=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(f).entries()),type=fd.record_type==='grading'?'gradings':'events',oldSource=fd.original_source;if(oldSource&&oldSource!==type&&fd.id)cmsRemove(oldSource,fd.id);let id=fd.id||cmsId(type,fd.title);if(type==='gradings'){const rec={id,title:fd.title,date:fd.date,start_time:fd.start_time,end_time:fd.end_time,region:fd.region||'WJO-wide',venue:fd.venue,status:['Open','Closed','Draft'].includes(fd.status)?fd.status:(fd.status==='Draft'?'Draft':'Open'),notes:fd.description,location:fd.location,image:fd.image};cmsUpsert(type,rec)}else{const rec={id,title:fd.title,date:fd.date,start_time:fd.start_time,end_time:fd.end_time,category:fd.category||'Event',region:fd.region||v46InferRegion(fd.location),venue:fd.venue,location:fd.location,status:['Published','Draft','Private'].includes(fd.status)?fd.status:'Published',desc:fd.description,image:fd.image};cmsUpsert(type,rec)}v46CloseModal('v46-event-modal');V46_CAL_STATE.month=fd.date.slice(0,7);render()}
window.v46SaveCalendarItem=v46SaveCalendarItem;
function v46DeleteCalendarItem(source,id){const x=v46AdminCalendarItems().find(i=>i.source===source&&i.id===id);if(x&&confirm(`Delete "${x.title}" from the local calendar data?`)){cmsRemove(source,id);render()}}
window.v46DeleteCalendarItem=v46DeleteCalendarItem;
function v46EscapeCSV(v){const s=String(v??'');return /[",\n]/.test(s)?'"'+s.replace(/"/g,'""')+'"':s}
function v46ExportMonthCSV(){const rows=v46FilteredItems();const headers=['record_type','id','title','date','start_time','end_time','category','region','venue','location','status','description','image'];const csv=[headers.join(','),...rows.map(x=>headers.map(h=>v46EscapeCSV(h==='record_type'?x.recordType:h==='description'?x.description:x[h]||'')).join(','))].join('\n');const blob=new Blob([csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download=`wjo-calendar-${V46_CAL_STATE.month}.csv`;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);cmsNotify('Month exported',`${rows.length} calendar record${rows.length===1?'':'s'} exported.`)}
window.v46ExportMonthCSV=v46ExportMonthCSV;
function v46DownloadImportTemplate(){const csv='record_type,id,title,date,start_time,end_time,category,region,venue,location,status,description,image\nevent,,Autumn Seminar,2026-10-10,10:00,15:00,Seminar,Northamptonshire,Daventry Community Centre,"Ashby Road, Daventry",Published,"Open training seminar for WJO students",event-levels.jpg\ngrading,,Regional Grading Day,2026-10-12,10:00,15:00,Grading,Northamptonshire,Daventry Community Centre,"Ashby Road, Daventry",Open,"Regional grading session",event-white-to-brown.jpg';const blob=new Blob([csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='wjo-calendar-import-template-v46.csv';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000)}
window.v46DownloadImportTemplate=v46DownloadImportTemplate;
function v46ParseCSV(text){const rows=[];let row=[],cell='',q=false;for(let i=0;i<text.length;i++){const c=text[i],n=text[i+1];if(c==='"'&&q&&n==='"'){cell+='"';i++;continue}if(c==='"'){q=!q;continue}if(c===','&&!q){row.push(cell);cell='';continue}if((c==='\n'||c==='\r')&&!q){if(c==='\r'&&n==='\n')i++;row.push(cell);cell='';if(row.some(v=>String(v).trim()!==''))rows.push(row);row=[];continue}cell+=c}row.push(cell);if(row.some(v=>String(v).trim()!==''))rows.push(row);if(!rows.length)return[];const head=rows.shift().map(x=>String(x).trim());return rows.map(r=>Object.fromEntries(head.map((h,i)=>[h,String(r[i]??'').trim()]))) }
function v46NormalizeImport(raw){const arr=Array.isArray(raw)?raw:Array.isArray(raw?.items)?raw.items:Array.isArray(raw?.events)?raw.events:[];return arr.map(x=>({...x,record_type:String(x.record_type||x.type||'event').toLowerCase()}))}
function v46ParseImport(text,fileName=''){const trimmed=String(text||'').trim();if(!trimmed)return[];if(fileName.toLowerCase().endsWith('.json')||trimmed.startsWith('[')||trimmed.startsWith('{'))return v46NormalizeImport(JSON.parse(trimmed));return v46NormalizeImport(v46ParseCSV(trimmed))}
function v46ResolveImportImage(v){if(!v)return'';if(/^data:|^assets\//.test(v))return v;let list=[];try{list=v42MediaLoad()}catch(e){}const m=list.find(x=>(x.name||'').toLowerCase()===String(v).toLowerCase()||(x.title||'').toLowerCase()===String(v).toLowerCase());return m?.src||v}
function v46ValidateImportRows(rows){return rows.map((r,i)=>{const errors=[];if(!r.title)errors.push('title is required');if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(r.date||''))errors.push('date must be YYYY-MM-DD');if(!['event','grading'].includes(r.record_type))errors.push('record_type must be event or grading');if(!r.venue)errors.push('venue is required');return{row:i+2,data:r,errors}})}
function v46OpenImport(){let modal=document.getElementById('v46-import-modal');if(modal)modal.remove();modal=document.createElement('div');modal.id='v46-import-modal';modal.className='v46-modal-backdrop open';modal.innerHTML=`<div class="v46-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"><div class="v46-modal-head"><div><div class="kicker">Batch import</div><h3>Import calendar records</h3></div><button class="v46-modal-close" type="button" onclick="v46CloseModal('v46-import-modal')">×</button></div><div class="v46-modal-body"><div class="v46-import-help"><b>Accepted formats: CSV or JSON.</b><br>Use ISO dates in <b>YYYY-MM-DD</b> format. <b>record_type</b> is either <b>event</b> or <b>grading</b>. The image column is optional and can contain a Media Library file name such as <b>event-levels.jpg</b> or an asset path. If <b>id</b> is blank, V46 updates an existing item when title + date match, otherwise it creates a new record.<code>record_type,id,title,date,start_time,end_time,category,region,venue,location,status,description,image</code><div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="cms-small-btn" type="button" onclick="v46DownloadImportTemplate()">DOWNLOAD CSV TEMPLATE</button></div></div><div class="v46-modal-form" style="margin-top:14px"><label>Choose CSV or JSON file<input id="v46-import-file" type="file" accept=".csv,.json,text/csv,application/json" onchange="v46ReadImportFile(this)"></label><label>Or paste CSV / JSON<textarea id="v46-import-text" style="min-height:180px" placeholder="Paste CSV rows or a JSON array here…"></textarea></label><div class="admin-actions-row"><button class="btn ghost" type="button" onclick="v46ValidateImport()">VALIDATE & PREVIEW</button><button class="btn red" type="button" onclick="v46ImportValidated()">IMPORT VALID ROWS</button></div><div id="v46-import-status" class="v46-import-status">Nothing validated yet.</div><div id="v46-import-preview" class="v46-import-preview"></div></div></div><div class="v46-modal-foot"><span style="font-size:11px;color:#8e98a4">Import uses the same local data store as Events and Gradings.</span><button class="btn ghost" type="button" onclick="v46CloseModal('v46-import-modal')">CLOSE</button></div></div>`;modal.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===modal)v46CloseModal('v46-import-modal')});document.body.appendChild(modal);document.body.style.overflow='hidden';window.V46_IMPORT_PREVIEW=null;window.V46_IMPORT_FILENAME=''}
window.v46OpenImport=v46OpenImport;
function v46ReadImportFile(input){const f=input.files?.[0];if(!f)return;window.V46_IMPORT_FILENAME=f.name;const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{const t=document.getElementById('v46-import-text');if(t)t.value=r.result;v46ValidateImport()};r.readAsText(f)}
window.v46ReadImportFile=v46ReadImportFile;
function v46ValidateImport(){const text=document.getElementById('v46-import-text')?.value||'',status=document.getElementById('v46-import-status'),preview=document.getElementById('v46-import-preview');try{const rows=v46ParseImport(text,window.V46_IMPORT_FILENAME||''),checked=v46ValidateImportRows(rows);window.V46_IMPORT_PREVIEW=checked;const valid=checked.filter(x=>!x.errors.length).length,bad=checked.length-valid;if(status)status.innerHTML=`<strong>${valid}</strong> valid row${valid===1?'':'s'}${bad?` • <strong>${bad}</strong> row${bad===1?'':'s'} need attention`:''}.`;if(preview)preview.innerHTML=checked.slice(0,12).map(x=>`<div class="v46-import-row ${x.errors.length?'bad':'ok'}"><b>Row ${x.row}: ${cmsEscape(x.data.title||'Untitled')}</b><br>${x.errors.length?cmsEscape(x.errors.join(' • ')):`${cmsEscape(x.data.record_type)} • ${cmsEscape(x.data.date)} • ${cmsEscape(x.data.venue)}`}</div>`).join('')+(checked.length>12?`<div class="v46-import-row">…and ${checked.length-12} more rows</div>`:'')}catch(err){window.V46_IMPORT_PREVIEW=null;if(status)status.textContent='Could not parse the import: '+err.message;if(preview)preview.innerHTML=''}}
window.v46ValidateImport=v46ValidateImport;
function v46ImportValidated(){if(!window.V46_IMPORT_PREVIEW)v46ValidateImport();const checked=window.V46_IMPORT_PREVIEW||[],valid=checked.filter(x=>!x.errors.length);if(!valid.length){alert('There are no valid rows to import yet. Validate the file and correct any errors first.');return}const d=cmsData();for(const c of valid){const r=c.data,type=r.record_type==='grading'?'gradings':'events',list=d[type]||[];const existing=r.id?list.find(x=>x.id===r.id):list.find(x=>String(x.title).toLowerCase()===String(r.title).toLowerCase()&&x.date===r.date);const id=existing?.id||r.id||cmsId(type,r.title);if(type==='gradings'){const rec={id,title:r.title,date:r.date,start_time:r.start_time||'',end_time:r.end_time||'',region:r.region||'WJO-wide',venue:r.venue,status:['Open','Closed','Draft'].includes(r.status)?r.status:'Open',notes:r.description||'',location:r.location||'',image:v46ResolveImportImage(r.image)};const ix=list.findIndex(x=>x.id===id);if(ix>=0)list[ix]={...list[ix],...rec,seed:false};else list.push({...rec,seed:false})}else{const rec={id,title:r.title,date:r.date,start_time:r.start_time||'',end_time:r.end_time||'',category:r.category||'Event',region:r.region||v46InferRegion(r.location),venue:r.venue,location:r.location||'',status:['Published','Draft','Private'].includes(r.status)?r.status:'Published',desc:r.description||'',image:v46ResolveImportImage(r.image)};const ix=list.findIndex(x=>x.id===id);if(ix>=0)list[ix]={...list[ix],...rec,seed:false};else list.push({...rec,seed:false})}d[type]=list}cmsSaveData(d);v45HydrateContentImages();cmsNotify('Calendar import complete',`${valid.length} record${valid.length===1?'':'s'} imported or updated.`);v46CloseModal('v46-import-modal');render()}
window.v46ImportValidated=v46ImportValidated;
function v46CalendarAdminRoute(){v46EnsureCalendarState();const all=v46AdminCalendarItems(),months=v46CalendarMonths(all),regions=[...new Set(all.map(x=>x.region).filter(Boolean))].sort(),statuses=v46StatusValues(all),filtered=v46FilteredItems();return adminShell('calendar','Scheduling tools','Event & grading calendar',`${cmsLiveStrip()}<div class="v46-calendar-admin"><section class="admin-panel light"><div class="v46-cal-intro"><div><div class="kicker">Month + week planning</div><h3>Front-end event and grading calendar</h3><p>Filter and edit the same Events and Gradings records that power the public diary. ${m===V46_CAL_STATE.month?'selected':''}>${v46MonthLabel(m)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>Category<select id="v46-cal-category"><option value="all">All // V46 backup identity while retaining V44/V45 local data compatibility.
cmsExportData=function(){const pkg={version:46,exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(),content:cmsData(),media:v42MediaLoad()};const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='wjo-content-backup-v59.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);cmsNotify('Backup created','V46 content and media were exported together.')};
window.cmsExportData=cmsExportData;
const _v45ImportBackup=cmsImportDataInput;
cmsImportDataInput=function(input){const f=input.files?.[0];if(!f)return;const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{try{const pkg=JSON.parse(r.result);const content=pkg.content||pkg;if(!content||!content.news||!content.events)throw new Error('Invalid file');content.version=WJO_CMS_VERSION;cmsSaveData(content);if(Array.isArray(pkg.media))v42MediaSave(pkg.media);v45HydrateContentImages();cmsNotify('Backup imported','Content and media have been restored in V46.');render()}catch(e){alert('That file is not a valid WJO content backup.')}};r.readAsText(f)};
window.cmsImportDataInput=cmsImportDataInput;
