Full WJO privacy wording</h2><p>WJO’s Privacy Notice is the current published source for its cookie and privacy statements.</p><a class="btn ghost" href="https://wjo.org.uk/privacy-notice/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">READ WJO PRIVACY NOTICE ↗</a></section></div><aside class="policy-sidebar"><div class="sidebar-card"><div class="kicker">Privacy</div><a class="policy-jump" href="#privacy-notice">Privacy Notice</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#data-protection">Data Protection</a><button class="btn red" type="button" onclick="openCookieSettingsV38()" style="margin-top:12px">COOKIE SETTINGS</button></div></aside></div></div></section></main>`);

  routes['data-protection']=()=>shell(`<main>${pageHero('DATA PROTECTION <em>& RETENTION.</em>','Privacy / customer data','A summary of the data-protection and retention commitments in WJO’s current published Privacy Notice.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="policy-page"><div class="policy-body"><section class="policy-section"><h2>1. Lawful use of personal data</h2><p>WJO’s published notice says personal data is used when the law allows it. The lawful bases it describes include performance of a contract, legitimate interests, consent where applicable and compliance with legal obligations.</p></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>2. Data minimisation and accuracy</h2><p>The notice asks people to keep their information accurate and current. WJO also distinguishes personal data from aggregated information that does not identify an individual.</p></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>3. Data security</h2><p>WJO states that it has measures intended to prevent personal data being accidentally lost, misused, accessed without authorisation, altered or disclosed, and that access is limited to people with a business need to know.</p></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>4. Retention</h2><p>WJO says it retains personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, including legal, accounting and reporting requirements. The notice says the appropriate period depends on the amount, nature and sensitivity of the information, risk, purpose and applicable legal requirements.</p><p>It also states that details of retention periods are available in WJO’s Retention Policy, which can be requested by contacting the organisation.</p></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>5. Individual rights</h2><p>The current notice describes rights to request access, correction, erasure in applicable circumstances, restriction, objection and transfer where applicable, and to withdraw consent where processing relies on consent.</p></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>6. Contact</h2><p>For privacy and data-protection requests: <a href="mailto:admin@wjo.org.uk">admin@wjo.org.uk</a> • <a href="tel:+441327342611">01327 342611</a>.</p><a class="btn red" href="https://wjo.org.uk/privacy-notice/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">FULL WJO PRIVACY NOTICE ↗</a></section></div><aside class="policy-sidebar"><div class="sidebar-card"><div class="kicker">Privacy hub</div><a class="policy-jump" href="#privacy-notice">Privacy Notice</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#cookie-policy">Cookie Information</a></div></aside></div></div></section></main>`);

  // Current events: remove the three invented grading records from old saved data and from future resets.
  const V59_SEED_BASE = cmsSeedData;
  cmsSeedData=function(){const d=V59_SEED_BASE();d.gradings=(d.gradings||[]).filter(x=>!['grading-regional-day','grading-junior-awards','grading-black-belt-prep'].includes(x.id));return d};
  try{
    const d=cmsData();
    d.gradings=(d.gradings||[]).filter(x=>!['grading-regional-day','grading-junior-awards','grading-black-belt-prep'].includes(x.id));
    // Correct seeded news records to published WJO material instead of invented dates/body copy.
    const realNews={
      'mental-health-january':{title:'Why is Jado Kuin Do so Important for Our Mental Health This January?',category:'Latest News',status:'Published',date:'2025-12-30',author:'Desrae Ogden',summary:'WJO discusses routine, goal-setting, focus, self-discipline, emotional balance and community through Jado Kuin Do training.',body:'WJO’s published article discusses the value of regular training for routine and goal-setting, the mind-body connection involved in focused martial arts practice, and the importance of training community and belonging.',external:'https://wjo.org.uk/why-is-jado-kuin-do-so-important-for-our-mental-health-this-january/'},
      'reflection-2025':{title:'2025 reflection letter from Grand Master Ogden',category:'Latest News',status:'Published',date:'2025-12-17',author:'Desrae Ogden',summary:'Grand Master Jake Ogden reflects on WJO growth, standards, community and the organisation’s commitment to healthier communities.',body:'Grand Master Jake Ogden reflects on WJO’s progress during 2025, thanks students and instructors for their commitment, and restates a focus on life skills, personal growth, wellbeing and unity.',external:'https://wjo.org.uk/letter-from-grand-master-ogden/'},
      'fun-awareness-day':{title:'Fun And Awareness Day – Daventry Community Centre',category:'Community',status:'Published',date:'2015-05-07',author:'Mark Desborough',summary:'A WJO community event in Daventry combining family activities, awareness sessions and local community involvement.',body:'WJO’s published community story covers the Fun and Awareness Day at Daventry Community Centre and the involvement of students, families and local organisations.',external:'https://wjo.org.uk/fun-and-awareness-day-daventry-community-centre/'},
      'social-character':{title:'Social Development and Character Building',category:'Development',status:'Published',date:'',author:'WJO',summary:'WJO describes how martial arts development includes physical, mental and social skills alongside technique.',body:'WJO’s published article explains that students develop physical, mental and social skills as they grow as Jado Kuin Do martial artists.',external:'https://wjo.org.uk/wjo-sparring/'},
      'jado-january-newsletter':{title:'JADO JANUARY NEWSLETTER',category:'WJO News',status:'Published',date:'',author:'WJO',summary:'Organisation news and updates published through WJO’s News and Blogs section.',body:'Read the current WJO News and Blogs section for the organisation’s published newsletter and updates.',external:'https://wjo.org.uk/news/'}
    };
    d.news=(d.news||[]).map(x=>realNews[x.id]?{...x,...realNews[x.id]}:x);
    cmsSaveData(d);
  }catch(e){}

  // Public news cards go straight to the source for seeded published stories.
  cmsNewsCard=function(x){
    const image=resolveAssetPath(x.image||'assets/news-newsletter.jpg');
    const cls=x.seed?'':' cms-public-added';
    const href=x.external||('#article?id='+encodeURIComponent(x.id));
    const ext=x.external?' target="_blank" rel="noopener"':'';
    const meta=[x.date?cmsFmtDate(x.date):'',x.author||''].filter(Boolean).map(v=>`<span>${cmsEscape(v)}</span>`).join('');
    return `<a class="news-card cms-clickable-news${cls}" style="--newsbg:url('${image}');position:relative" href="${href}"${ext}><div class="tag">${cmsEscape(x.category||'WJO News')}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.title)}</h3><p style="color:#d3d7de">${cmsEscape(x.summary||'')}</p>${meta?`<div class="cms-record-meta">${meta}</div>`:''}<span class="chip-soft" style="margin-top:12px">READ ARTICLE ${x.external?'↗':'→'}</span></a>`;
  };
  routes.news=()=>{const items=cmsCollection('news').filter(x=>String(x.status).toLowerCase()==='published').sort((a,b)=>String(b.date||'').localeCompare(String(a.date||'')));return shell(`<main>${pageHero('STORIES FROM <em>THE WJO.</em>','News & insights','Published WJO news, training insight, student stories and community activity.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="news-grid">${items.map(cmsNewsCard).join('')}</div></div></section></main>`)};

  // Event imagery: use the official WJO/Jado badge rather than weak generated event art.
  cmsEventRow=function(x){const cls=x.seed?'':' cms-public-added';const label=x._type==='gradings'?'GRADING':(x.category||'WJO EVENT');return `<article class="event-row-v28 cms-clickable-event${cls}" style="position:relative" tabindex="0" role="button" onclick="cmsShowEvent('${x._type}','${x.id}')" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();cmsShowEvent('${x._type}','${x.id}')} "><div class="v59-event-art"><img src="${V59_CREST}" alt="Jado Kuin Do badge"><span>${cmsEscape(label)}</span></div><div class="event-date-v28"><div class="day">${String(new Date(x.date+'T12:00:00').getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}</div><div><div class="month">${new Date(x.date+'T12:00:00').toLocaleString('en-GB',{month:'short'}).toUpperCase()}</div><div class="weekday">${new Date(x.date+'T12:00:00').toLocaleString('en-GB',{weekday:'short'})}</div></div></div><div class="event-body-v28"><div class="kicker">${cmsEscape(label)}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.title)}</h3><p>${cmsEscape(x.desc||x.notes||'')}</p><span class="venue">${cmsEscape(x.venue||'')}${x.location?' • '+cmsEscape(x.location):''}</span></div><button class="btn ghost event-detail-button" type="button">VIEW DETAILS</button></article>`};
  cmsShowEvent=function(type,id){const x=cmsRecord(type,id);if(!x)return;v42OpenDetail({title:x.title,category:type==='gradings'?'Grading • '+(x.region||'WJO'):(x.category||'WJO Event'),date:x.date,venue:x.venue,location:x.location||x.region||'',image:V59_CREST,body:x.desc||x.notes||''})};
  routes.events=()=>{let items=cmsCombinedEvents();const today=new Date();today.setHours(0,0,0,0);items=items.filter(e=>{if(!e.date)return false;const d=new Date(e.date+'T12:00:00');return !isNaN(d)&&d>=today});const months=[...new Set(items.map(e=>e.date.slice(0,7)))].slice(0,8);return shell(`<main>${pageHero('WHAT’S COMING UP <em>AT WJO.</em>','Events & gradings','Current and upcoming WJO events and grading dates.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="event-view-toolbar"><div class="event-view-switch"><button class="active" type="button" data-view="list" onclick="setEventView('list')">LIST</button><button type="button" data-view="month" onclick="setEventView('month')">MONTH</button></div></div><div id="events-list-pane" class="event-view-pane"><div class="event-list-v28">${items.length?items.map(cmsEventRow).join(''):'<div class="content-card"><h3>No upcoming events listed</h3><p>Please check the official WJO events page for the latest dates.</p></div>'}</div></div><div id="events-month-pane" class="event-view-pane" hidden><div class="event-months">${months.map(m=>{const [y,mo]=m.split('-').map(Number);return cmsCalendarMonth(y,mo-1,items)}).join('')}</div></div><div class="v59-source-note">Event dates are taken from WJO event records in this build. <a href="https://wjo.org.uk/events/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Check the official WJO events page ↗</a>.</div></div></section></main>`)};

  // School cards/details: if no genuine venue image exists, show the official badge.
  cmsSchoolCard=function(x){const src=x.image?resolveAssetPath(x.image):V59_CREST;const fallback=x.image?'':' v59-school-fallback';return `<a class="cms-school-card-link" href="#school?id=${encodeURIComponent(x.id)}" aria-label="View ${cmsEscape(x.name)} details"><article class="cms-school-card ${x.seed?'':'cms-public-added'}" style="position:relative"><div class="cms-school-image${fallback}"><img src="${src}" alt="${x.image?cmsEscape(x.name):'Jado Kuin Do badge'}"></div><div class="kicker">${cmsEscape(x.region||'WJO')}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.name)}</h3><p>${cmsEscape(x.address||'')}<br><b>${cmsEscape(x.town||'')}</b> ${cmsEscape(x.postcode||'')}</p><div class="cms-school-tags">${(x.programmes||[]).map(p=>`<span>${cmsEscape(p)}</span>`).join('')}${(x.days||[]).map(p=>`<span>${cmsEscape(p)}</span>`).join('')}</div><span class="cms-school-view">VIEW SCHOOL →</span></article></a>`};
  routes['find-school']=()=>{const list=cmsCollection('schools').filter(x=>String(x.status).toLowerCase()==='live');return shell(`<main>${pageHero('FIND YOUR <em>WJO.</em>','School finder','Search WJO venues by town, postcode, programme or training day.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="school-toolbar-v5"><input id="cms-school-q" class="field location-field" placeholder="Town, postcode, programme or day" oninput="cmsFilterSchools()"></div><div class="cms-school-grid" style="margin-top:18px">${list.map(x=>`<div data-cms-school-search="${cmsEscape((x.name+' '+x.town+' '+x.postcode+' '+x.region+' '+(x.days||[]).join(' ')+' '+(x.programmes||[]).join(' ')).toLowerCase())}">${cmsSchoolCard(x)}</div>`).join('')}</div><div class="v59-source-note"><a href="https://wjo.org.uk/find-a-school/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the official WJO school directory ↗</a> for the latest class information.</div></div></section></main>`)};
  routes.school=()=>{
    const id=hashParams().get('id');
    const live=cmsCollection('schools').filter(x=>String(x.status).toLowerCase()==='live');
    const x=(id?cmsRecord('schools',id):null)||live[0];
    if(!x)return shell(`<main>${pageHero('FIND YOUR <em>WJO.</em>','School details','This school could not be found.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><a class="btn red" href="#find-school">BACK TO SCHOOL FINDER</a></div></section></main>`);
    const sessions=Array.isArray(x.sessions)?x.sessions:[];
    const schedule=sessions.length?sessions.map(row=>`<tr><td><b>${cmsEscape(row[0]||'')}</b></td><td><b>${cmsEscape(row[1]||'')}</b></td><td>${cmsEscape(row[2]||'')}</td><td>${cmsEscape(row[3]||'')}</td><td><a class="btn dark" href="#contact">BOOK</a></td></tr>`).join(''):`<tr><td colspan="5">Please contact WJO for the current class timetable at this venue.</td></tr>`;
    const programmes=Array.isArray(x.programmes)?x.programmes:[];
    const days=Array.isArray(x.days)?x.days:[];
    const progs=programmes.length?programmes.join(' • '):'Contact WJO for current programme details';
    const dayText=days.length?days.join(' / '):'Contact WJO for current training days';
    const maps='https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query='+encodeURIComponent(x.address||[x.town,x.postcode].filter(Boolean).join(' '));
    const image=x.image?resolveAssetPath(x.image):'';
    const venuePanel=image?`<div class="v43-school-hero-image"><img src="${image}" alt="${cmsEscape(x.name)}"></div>`:`<div class="v43-school-hero-image v59-school-fallback"><img src="${V59_CREST}" alt="Jado Kuin Do badge"></div>`;
    return shell(`<main>${pageHero(`JADO KUIN DO <em>${cmsEscape(String(x.town||x.name).toUpperCase())}.</em>`,'Local academy',`${cmsEscape(x.name)} • ${cmsEscape(x.region||'WJO')}`)}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap grid-2"><div><div class="kicker">Your local WJO academy</div><h2 style="font-size:47px;line-height:1">${cmsEscape(x.name)}</h2><p style="color:#aeb3bc">${cmsEscape(x.address||[x.town,x.postcode].filter(Boolean).join(', '))}</p><div class="school-meta">${programmes.map(p=>`<span class="pill">${cmsEscape(p)}</span>`).join('')}<span class="pill">${cmsEscape(dayText)}</span></div><div class="hero-actions"><a class="btn red" href="#contact">BOOK FREE TASTER</a><a class="btn ghost" href="${maps}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">GET DIRECTIONS ↗</a><a class="btn ghost" href="#find-school">ALL SCHOOLS</a></div></div>${venuePanel}</div></section><section class="page-section cream"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-header"><div><div class="kicker">Weekly timetable</div><h2>Choose your class.</h2></div></div><div style="overflow:auto"><table class="timetable">${schedule}</table></div></div></section><section class="page-section"><div class="wrap grid-3"><div class="content-card"><h3>What to bring</h3><p>Comfortable sports clothing and water. No uniform is needed for a trial session.</p></div><div class="content-card"><h3>Programmes</h3><p>${cmsEscape(progs)}</p></div><div class="content-card"><h3>Questions?</h3><p>Contact WJO before your visit if you need help choosing the right class.</p></div></div><div class="v59-source-note"><a href="https://wjo.org.uk/find-a-school/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Check the official WJO school directory ↗</a> for the latest class information.</div></section></main>`)
  };

  // Keep public directories clean of implementation notices.
  const V59_INSTRUCTORS_BASE=routes.instructors; routes.instructors=function(){return V59_INSTRUCTORS_BASE().replace(/<div class="cms-public-note">[\s\S]*?<\/div>/,'')};
  const V59_LEADERSHIP_BASE=routes.leadership; routes.leadership=function(){return V59_LEADERSHIP_BASE().replace(/<div class="cms-public-note">[\s\S]*?<\/div>/,'')};

  // Contact privacy wording.
  const V59_CONTACT_BASE=routes.contact; routes.contact=function(){return V59_CONTACT_BASE().replace('Read WJO privacy and cookie information or change your cookie preferences.','Read WJO privacy and cookie information or change your cookie preferences.')};

  // Admin language: truthful about local storage without calling the interface a demo/mockup.
  cmsUpsert=function(type,record){const d=cmsData();const list=d[type]||[];const idx=list.findIndex(x=>x.id===record.id);if(idx>=0)list[idx]={...list[idx],...record,seed:false,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()};else list.unshift({...record,seed:false,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()});d[type]=list;cmsSaveData(d);cmsNotify('Saved','Website content updated in this local build.')};
  cmsRemove=function(type,id){const d=cmsData();d[type]=(d[type]||[]).filter(x=>x.id!==id);cmsSaveData(d);cmsNotify('Item deleted','Website content updated in this local build.')};
  cmsResetData=function(){if(!confirm('Reset local content back to the supplied WJO records?'))return;const d=cmsSeedData();cmsSaveData(d);cmsNotify('Local content reset','Local changes have been cleared.');render()};window.cmsResetData=cmsResetData;
  cmsBackupControls=function(){return `<div class="cms-data-actions"><button class="btn ghost" type="button" onclick="cmsExportData()">EXPORT JSON</button><label class="btn ghost" style="cursor:pointer">IMPORT JSON<input type="file" accept="application/json" style="display:none" onchange="cmsImportDataInput(this)"></label><button class="btn dark" type="button" onclick="cmsResetData()">RESET LOCAL CONTENT</button></div>`};
  cmsLiveStrip=function(){return `<div class="cms-live-strip"><div><strong>Local content store</strong><span> • Changes in this single-file build are stored on this device.</span></div>${cmsBackupControls()}</div>`};

  // Prevent older visible design-language notices from surviving route output.
  const V59_RENDER_BASE=render;
  render=function(){const r=V59_RENDER_BASE.apply(this,arguments);try{const site=document.getElementById('site');if(site){site.querySelectorAll('.cms-public-note,.mockup-note,.v47-version-chip').forEach(x=>x.remove());site.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(el=>{if(el.children.length===0){const t=(el.textContent||'').trim();if(/^live demo data/i.test(t))el.remove();}})}}catch(e){}return r};
})();

(function(){
  // One dedicated page for the Super J's animal awards. The five award names and

  // descriptions supplied for this redesign.
  const V60_ANIMALS=[

    {name:'Crane',image:'assets/mascot-crane.jpg',meaning:'Focuses on balance, posture and body control.'},
    {name:'Panther',image:'assets/mascot-panther.jpg',meaning:'Develops speed, agility and quick reactions.'},
    {name:'Dragon',image:'assets/mascot-dragon.jpg',meaning:'Encourages imagination, spirit and fluid motion.'}
  ];
  routes['jado-animals']=()=>shell(`<main>${pageHero('FIVE ANIMALS. <em>ONE JOURNEY.</em>',"Super J's animal awards",'Five progressive animal awards help younger learners build skills step by step before moving towards their first full White Belt grading.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="v60-animal-intro"><strong>Super J's is for ages 3–6.</strong> The syllabus uses learning through fun, with Snake, Tiger, Crane, Panther and Dragon as progressive awards. Each stage helps prepare younger students for the next part of their Jado journey.</div><div class="v60-animal-detail-grid">${V60_ANIMALS.map((a,i)=>`<article class="v60-animal-detail"><div class="v60-animal-media" style="--animal:url('${a.image}')" role="img" aria-label="${a.name} animal award"></div><div class="v60-animal-copy"><div class="kicker">Animal award ${i+1}</div><h3>${a.name}</h3><p>${a.meaning}</p></div></article>`).join('')}</div></div></section><section class="page-section cream"><div class="wrap grid-2"><div><div class="kicker">What comes next?</div><h2 style="font-size:50px;line-height:1">From animal awards to Confident Kidz.</h2><p>When the Super J's programme is completed, WJO says learners are ready to progress into Confident Kidz and continue their development.</p></div><div class="content-card light"><h3>Explore the programme</h3><p>See how Super J's uses play, teamwork, movement, concentration and age-specific learning.</p><a class="btn dark" href="#super-js">SUPER J'S PROGRAMME</a></div></div></section>${cta()}</main>`);

  // Home: keep the strongest layout, remove implementation/design commentary and the
  // duplicated belt strip, and send the five animal tiles to the dedicated page.
  const V60_HOME_BASE=routes.home;
  routes.home=function(){let html=V60_HOME_BASE();
    html=html.replace(/<section class="grade-home-v55[\s\S]*?<\/section>/,'');
    html=html.replace(/<section class="v47-section soft" style="padding-top:0">[\s\S]*?<\/section>/,'');
    html=html.replace('Instead of three equal cards, the programmes become large editorial stories. They feel more valuable, read more clearly and give the photography room to do its job.','Choose the programme that best matches the student’s age and training goals. Each route has a clear progression into the wider WJO syllabus.');
    html=html.replace('The new visual system gives real people and real WJO material much more space. Video becomes editorial content rather than a small embedded box lost inside a page.','Jado Kuin Do combines practical self-defence, natural movement and life skills. Hear directly from Grand Master Ogden, students and families about what the training means to them.');
    html=html.replace('This becomes a signature visual moment rather than a normal row of tiles. Each animal can eventually carry its own motion, sound, story and progression content.','The five Super J’s animal awards form a progressive learning journey for younger children. Open the Jado Animals page to see what each award develops.');
    html=html.replace('The calendar becomes more visual on the homepage: big dates, clear categories and a direct route into the fully functional V46 event system underneath.','See current WJO gradings, organisation events and key dates, with the full calendar available on the Events page.');
    const start=html.indexOf('<div class="v47-animal-grid">');
    if(start>-1){const end=html.indexOf('</section>',start);if(end>-1){const grid=`<div class="v47-animal-grid">${V60_ANIMALS.map(a=>`<a class="v47-animal v60-animal-link-card" href="#jado-animals" style="--animal:url('${a.image}')"><div class="v47-animal-copy"><h3>${a.name}</h3><p>Explore the ${a.name} award →</p></div></a>`).join('')}</div></div></div>`;html=html.slice(0,start)+grid+html.slice(end)}}
    return html;
  };

  // Super J's: use WJO's published programme content and a single clear route to the animal page.
  routes['super-js']=()=>shell(`<main>${pageHero("BIG SKILLS FOR <em>LITTLE MARTIAL ARTISTS.</em>","Super J's • Ages 3–6",'A fun, vibrant and age-specific introduction to Jado Kuin Do built around learning through play.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap grid-2"><div><div class="kicker">Learning through fun</div><h2 style="font-size:48px;line-height:1">Movement. Teamwork. Concentration. Achievement.</h2><p style="color:#aeb3bc">WJO's Super J's curriculum is designed for younger learners aged 3–6. Training uses play to develop balance, coordination, teamwork, movement, concentration, inclusion and achievement in a disciplined but enjoyable class.</p><div class="hero-actions"><a class="btn red" href="#jado-animals">EXPLORE THE FIVE ANIMALS</a><a class="btn ghost" href="#find-school">FIND A CLASS</a></div></div><div class="v43-school-hero-image"><img src="assets/program-superjs.png" alt="Super J's martial arts training"></div></div></section><section class="page-section alt"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-header"><div><div class="kicker">How children learn</div><h2>Four ideas run through the syllabus.</h2></div><p>Four learning elements sit alongside the progressive animal awards and help shape each child's development.</p></div><div class="grid-4"><div class="content-card"><h3>Creativity</h3><p>Learning through movement, play and age-appropriate challenges.</p></div><div class="content-card"><h3>Communication</h3><p>Listening, responding and expressing ideas while training with others.</p></div><div class="content-card"><h3>Critical thinking</h3><p>Working things out, following instructions and developing concentration.</p></div><div class="content-card"><h3>Collaboration</h3><p>Working together, taking turns and learning through teamwork.</p></div></div></div></section><section class="page-section cream"><div class="wrap grid-3"><div class="content-card light info-image-card" style="--cardbg:url('assets/superj-play.png');--cardpos:center center"><h3>Play with purpose</h3><p>Age-specific activities make repetition   // Keep the Jado Animals page discoverable in mobile navigation and the all-pages index.

  if(typeof V10_PAGE_INDEX!=='undefined'&&!V10_PAGE_INDEX.some(x=>x[1]==='jado-animals'))V10_PAGE_INDEX.push(['Jado Animals','jado-animals']);

    ['Published WJO news, training insight, student stories and community activity.','WJO news, training insight, student stories and community activity.'],

    ['The published notice lists identity and contact information, training and attendance records, health information, technical and usage data, profile information, marketing and communication preferences, financial information and transaction data.','We may hold identity and contact information, training and attendance records, health information, technical and usage data, profile information, marketing and communication preferences, financial information and transaction data.'],

// ======================= V61 LOCAL NEWS + ADMIN UX =======================
(function(){
  // Preserve an original-source reference in Admin while keeping all public reading local.
  if(CMS_FIELDS.news&&!CMS_FIELDS.news.some(f=>f.name==='sourceUrl'))CMS_FIELDS.news.push({name:'sourceUrl',label:'Original WJO source (reference only)',placeholder:'https://wjo.org.uk/...'});

  const V61_NEWS={
    'september-october-2026':{
      id:'september-october-2026',title:'September and October at Jado Kuin Do',category:'Latest News',status:'Published',date:'2026-09-16',author:'Desrae Ogden',summary:'Grading, preparation and progress across the autumn WJO calendar, including what grading represents and how students can prepare.',image:'assets/news-newsletter.jpg',sourceUrl:'https://wjo.org.uk/september-and-october-at-jado-kuin-do/',
      body:`September and October are important months in the Jado Kuin Do calendar, with many students preparing for their next grading and reflecting on how far their training has progressed.\n\nA belt is a visible sign of progress, but grading also recognises knowledge, effort, discipline, attitude and personal development. Students move through the coloured belts, the three Brown Belt stages and then towards Black Belt.\n\nBlack Belt is not the end of learning. WJO continues progression through Level Gradings and Degree Gradings, giving experienced practitioners further challenges and opportunities to improve.\n\nGood preparation comes from regular classes, strong basics, purposeful practice, asking questions and listening carefully to instructor feedback. Rest, hydration and arriving ready to learn also help.\n\nGrading is not about being perfect. It is an opportunity to demonstrate progress, trust your training and enjoy the next step of your own Jado journey.`},
    'mental-health-january':{
      title:'Why is Jado Kuin Do so Important for Our Mental Health This January?',category:'Latest News',status:'Published',date:'2025-12-30',author:'Desrae Ogden',summary:'How routine, focus, goal-setting, community and mind-body training can support wellbeing through Jado Kuin Do.',sourceUrl:'https://wjo.org.uk/why-is-jado-kuin-do-so-important-for-our-mental-health-this-january/',
      body:`January can bring fresh goals, but shorter days, cold weather and pressure to make changes can also affect motivation and wellbeing. Jado Kuin Do offers more than physical exercise by combining movement with focus, self-discipline and emotional control.\n\nRegular classes create routine and achievable goals. Progressing through training and belt grades gives students a structured way to recognise improvement while building confidence and concentration.\n\nThe social side of training matters too. Practising alongside other students creates connection, support and a sense of belonging, which can be especially valuable when people feel isolated or under pressure.\n\nBy bringing together physical activity, mental focus and a supportive training environment, Jado Kuin Do can help students approach the year with greater clarity, resilience and calm.`},
    'reflection-2025':{
      title:'2025 reflection letter from Grand Master Ogden',category:'Latest News',status:'Published',date:'2025-12-17',author:'Desrae Ogden',summary:'Grand Master Jake Ogden reflects on WJO growth, standards, community and the organisation’s commitment to healthier communities.',sourceUrl:'https://wjo.org.uk/letter-from-grand-master-ogden/',
      body:`Grand Master Jake Ogden reflects on a year of growth for Jado Kuin Do and thanks students and instructors for the time, effort and commitment they have given to the organisation.\n\nHe highlights the importance of maintaining WJO standards and values while continuing to grow as a family-led organisation. The strength of the community is seen not only in training, but in the way students, families and instructors support and encourage one another.\n\nLooking ahead, the organisation’s aim remains to inspire healthier communities through life skills that extend beyond the training hall, creating an environment where personal growth, wellbeing and unity can continue to develop.`},
    'fun-awareness-day':{
      title:'Fun And Awareness Day – Daventry Community Centre',category:'Community',status:'Published',date:'2015-05-07',author:'Mark Desborough',summary:'A sold-out WJO community day in Daventry combined martial arts activities with practical safety awareness for children.',sourceUrl:'https://wjo.org.uk/fun-and-awareness-day-daventry-community-centre/',
      body:`Sifu Williams organised a Jado fun and awareness day to support renovation work at Daventry Community Centre. The event sold out, with 46 children aged between six and thirteen taking part.\n\nThe programme mixed Jado games and pad work with practical safety sessions. Local community support officers discussed personal safety, a police dog handler explained how police dogs work, and children had the chance to learn about police equipment.\n\nA stranger-awareness workshop helped children practise simple responses to unsafe situations, while the wider day kept the learning positive and engaging. Each child received a goody bag, and the event raised £150 for the community centre.\n\nFeedback from families was very positive, showing how martial arts activity can sit alongside wider community education and confidence-building.`},
    'social-character':{
      title:'Social Development and Character Building',category:'Development',status:'Published',date:'',author:'WJO',summary:'How Jado training develops confidence, belonging, responsibility and character alongside physical technique.',sourceUrl:'https://wjo.org.uk/wjo-sparring/',
      body:`Jado Kuin Do develops more than physical technique. As students improve their martial arts skills, training also encourages confidence, responsibility, mental strength and social development.\n\nTraining together gives students and instructors a shared purpose. Wearing the Gi, practising as a group and working towards common goals can strengthen teamwork and the feeling of belonging to a community.\n\nCharacter development is part of that journey. Students are encouraged to take responsibility for their actions, develop resilience and make positive choices rather than simply looking for instant results.\n\nThese personal and social skills sit alongside health, self-defence and technical development, helping the benefits of Jado Kuin Do extend beyond the training hall.`},
    'jado-january-newsletter':{
      title:'JADO JANUARY NEWSLETTER',category:'WJO News',status:'Published',date:'2026-01-20',author:'Desrae Ogden',summary:'The January WJO newsletter and organisation update for students, parents and instructors.',sourceUrl:'https://wjo.org.uk/jado-january-newsletter/',
      body:`Welcome to the January WJO newsletter. January is a chance to look ahead to the year’s training, gradings, events and community activity across the organisation.\n\nStudents, parents and instructors can use the WJO news area to keep up with organisation announcements, important dates and developments from across the Jado community.\n\nKeep checking club communications and the WJO events calendar throughout the year for current training, grading and organisation information.`}
  };

  // One-time/local migration: seeded articles become local records; user-edited records are respected.
  try{
    const d=cmsData();
    d.news=Array.isArray(d.news)?d.news:[];
    for(const [id,data] of Object.entries(V61_NEWS)){
      const idx=d.news.findIndex(x=>x.id===id);
      if(idx<0){d.news.unshift({...data,seed:true})}
      else if(d.news[idx].seed!==false || d.news[idx].external){d.news[idx]={...d.news[idx],...data,seed:true,external:''}}
      else if(d.news[idx].external){d.news[idx].external=''}
    }
    d.news=d.news.map(x=>({...x,external:''}));
    cmsSaveData(d);
  }catch(e){}

  // News is now entirely local. Original URLs remain an Admin-only reference field.
  cmsNewsCard=function(x){
    const image=resolveAssetPath(x.image||'assets/news-newsletter.jpg');
    const cls=x.seed?'':' cms-public-added';
    const meta=[x.date?cmsFmtDate(x.date):'',x.author||''].filter(Boolean).map(v=>`<span>${cmsEscape(v)}</span>`).join('');
    return `<a class="news-card cms-clickable-news${cls}" style="--newsbg:url('${image}');position:relative" href="#article?id=${encodeURIComponent(x.id)}" aria-label="Read ${cmsEscape(x.title)}"><div class="tag">${cmsEscape(x.category||'WJO News')}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.title)}</h3><p style="color:#d3d7de">${cmsEscape(x.summary||'')}</p>${meta?`<div class="cms-record-meta">${meta}</div>`:''}<span class="chip-soft" style="margin-top:12px">READ ARTICLE →</span></a>`;
  };
  routes.news=()=>{const items=cmsCollection('news').filter(x=>String(x.status).toLowerCase()==='published').sort((a,b)=>String(b.date||'').localeCompare(String(a.date||'')));return shell(`<main>${pageHero('STORIES FROM <em>THE WJO.</em>','News & insights','WJO news, training insight, student stories and community activity.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="news-grid">${items.map(cmsNewsCard).join('')}</div></div></section></main>`)};

  const V61_ARTICLE_BASE=routes.article;
  routes.article=function(){return V61_ARTICLE_BASE()};

  // Record rows are selectable and always scroll to the editor, especially on phones.
  cmsAdminManager=function(type,title,subtitle,fields){
    const list=cmsCollection(type);
    const rows=list.map(x=>`<article class="cms-record cms-record-v42 cms-record-v61" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Edit ${cmsEscape(x.title||x.name||x.school||'item')}" onclick="cmsEditRecord('${type}','${x.id}')" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();cmsEditRecord('${type}','${x.id}')} ">${v45AdminThumb(type,x)}<div><h4>${cmsEscape(x.title||x.name||x.school||'Untitled')}</h4><p>${cmsEscape(x.summary||x.desc||x.notes||x.address||x.role||'')}</p><div class="cms-record-meta"><span>${cmsEscape(x.status||'Live')}</span>${x.date?`<span>${cmsFmtDate(x.date)}</span>`:''}${x.category?`<span>${cmsEscape(x.category)}</span>`:''}${x.region?`<span>${cmsEscape(x.region)}</span>`:''}</div>${(x.image||x.photo)?'<span class="v45-linked-badge">Image linked</span>':''}<span class="v61-edit-hint">Tap to edit</span></div><div class="cms-record-actions"><button class="cms-small-btn" type="button" onclick="event.stopPropagation();cmsEditRecord('${type}','${x.id}')">EDIT</button><button class="cms-small-btn danger" type="button" onclick="event.stopPropagation();cmsDeleteRecord('${type}','${x.id}')">DELETE</button></div></article>`).join('');
    const formFields=fields.map(f=>cmsFieldMarkup(f)).join('');
    return adminShell(type,'Live content','Manage '+subtitle,`${cmsLiveStrip()}<div class="cms-manager-grid"><section class="cms-list-card"><div class="cms-card-head"><div><div class="kicker">Current public data</div><h3>${title}</h3></div><span class="status-chip ok">${list.length} records</span></div><div class="cms-card-body"><div class="cms-list">${rows||'<div class="cms-empty">No records yet. Add the first one using the editor.</div>'}</div></div></section><aside id="cms-editor-${type}" class="cms-editor-card"><div class="cms-card-head"><div><div class="kicker">Add / edit</div><h3 id="cms-editor-title-${type}">New ${subtitle.replace(/s$/,'')}</h3></div><button class="cms-small-btn" type="button" onclick="cmsClearForm('${type}')">CLEAR</button></div><div class="cms-card-body"><form id="cms-form-${type}" class="cms-form" onsubmit="cmsSubmitForm(event,'${type}')"><input type="hidden" name="id">${formFields}<div class="cms-form-actions"><button class="btn red" type="submit">SAVE & PUBLISH</button><button class="btn ghost" type="button" onclick="cmsClearForm('${type}')">NEW ITEM</button></div></form><div class="cms-backup-box"><p>Changes and selected images are stored on this device and reflected on the website pages in this single-file build.</p></div></div></aside></div>`)
  };

  const V61_EDIT_BASE=cmsEditRecord;
  cmsEditRecord=function(type,id){
    V61_EDIT_BASE(type,id);
    const editor=document.getElementById('cms-editor-'+type)||document.querySelector('.cms-editor-card');
    if(!editor)return;
    editor.classList.remove('v61-editor-focus');void editor.offsetWidth;editor.classList.add('v61-editor-focus');
    clearTimeout(window._v61EditorScroll);
    window._v61EditorScroll=setTimeout(()=>{
      const header=document.querySelector('.header');
      const top=window.scrollY+editor.getBoundingClientRect().top-(header?header.getBoundingClientRect().height:0)-14;
      window.scrollTo({top:Math.max(0,top),behavior:'smooth'});
      setTimeout(()=>editor.classList.remove('v61-editor-focus'),1000);
    },90);
  };
  window.cmsEditRecord=cmsEditRecord;

  // Redesign the post-Black Belt area for contrast and hierarchy.
  const V61_GRADE_BASE=routes['grade-order'];
  routes['grade-order']=function(){
    const original=V61_GRADE_BASE();
    const old=`<section class="page-section cream"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-header"><div><div class="kicker">Beyond Black Belt</div><h2>The journey continues.</h2></div><p>WJO's current grading guidance makes clear that achieving Black Belt starts another stage of learning rather than ending the journey.</p></div><div class="v60-beyond"><div class="v60-beyond-card"><h3>Level Gradings</h3><p>Black Belts can continue developing their skills, knowledge and understanding through further Level Gradings.</p></div><div class="v60-beyond-card"><h3>Degree Gradings</h3><p>Degree Gradings provide continued progression through the Black Belt ranks as practitioners keep learning and improving.</p></div></div></div></section>`;
    const fresh=`<section class="page-section v61-beyond-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="v61-beyond-head"><div><div class="kicker">Beyond Black Belt</div><h2>The journey continues.</h2></div><p>Achieving Black Belt begins another stage of learning. WJO continues to provide structured progression for practitioners who want to keep developing their skill, knowledge and understanding.</p></div><div class="v61-beyond-grid"><article class="v61-beyond-card" data-mark="L"><span class="v61-beyond-chip">Black Belt progression</span><span class="v61-beyond-arrow">01</span><h3>Level Gradings</h3><p>Level Gradings give Black Belts further opportunities to develop technique, understanding and proficiency after achieving their initial Black Belt.</p></article><article class="v61-beyond-card" data-mark="D"><span class="v61-beyond-chip">Advanced progression</span><span class="v61-beyond-arrow">02</span><h3>Degree Gradings</h3><p>Degree Gradings continue the Black Belt pathway as experienced practitioners progress through higher ranks while continuing to learn and improve.</p></article></div></div></section>`;
    return original.includes(old)?original.replace(old,fresh):original;
  };

  // Keep export naming aligned with this release.
  const V61_EXPORT_BASE=cmsExportData;
  cmsExportData=function(){
    try{const pkg={version:61,exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(),content:cmsData(),media:v42MediaLoad()};const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='wjo-content-backup-v61.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);cmsNotify('Backup created','Content and media library were exported together.')}catch(e){V61_EXPORT_BASE()}
  };window.cmsExportData=cmsExportData;
